articles.titleEn: KT, 6000만 생활 접점에 '모두의 AI' 심는다
summaryLinesEn: 6000만 이상 규모의 디지털·생활 서비스 접점에 더해 전국 KT 유통망과 IT서포터즈를 활용해 AI 체험과 교육을 제공할 계획이다.
KT 컨소시엄은 정부가 추진하는 '모두의 AI' 사업에서 이용자의 질문과 목적을 파악하는 범용 AI 에이전트를 중심으로 공공 AI 에이전트와 교육·금융·쇼핑·주거 등 분야별 전문 서비스를 하나로 연결한다고 27일 밝혔다. '모두의 AI' 범용 서비스는 앱과 웹 형태로 제공된다.

(NYSE:GS) and Intel Corporation (NASDAQ:INTC), as the two-year-old company pushes deeper into corporate marketing subscriptions. Why This Matters A Wall Street bank and a chipmaker in […]
articles.titleEn: Goldman Sachs (GS) & Intel (INTC) Just Backed the Same AI Video Startup
summaryLinesEn: On August 17, The Financial Times reported that AI video startup Higgsfield raised $400 million at a $5.4 billion valuation from investors.
While we acknowledge the potential of GS as an investment, we believe certain AI stocks offer greater upside potential and carry less downside risk.

Higgsfield's annualized revenue reached $700 million in August, up from just $20 million a year earlier, and the share of revenue coming from businesses rather than individual creators jumped from under 25% in January to a majority today.

articles.title: Is Arista Networks (ANET) Undervalued As AI Data Center Regulation Draws Political Scrutiny?
articles.descEn: The latest debate over AI data center regulation has pushed Arista Networks (ANET) into the spotlight, as Barclays flags potential political risk for the broader AI Data Center Index ahead of the US midterm election. For investors watching Arista Networks, the latest regulatory headlines arrive after a strong run, with the share price at US$190.94 and a 30 day share price return of 9.74% feeding into a 42.92% year to date share price return and a 5 year total shareholder return of about 7x...
articles.titleEn: Is Arista Networks (ANET) Undervalued As AI Data Center Regulation Draws Political Scrutiny?
summaryLinesEn: At a last close of $190.94 versus a narrative fair value around $241.82, Arista Networks is framed as undervalued, with that gap tied directly to its AI networking story.

Accelerated adoption of AI and machine learning workloads is significantly increasing demand for high-bandwidth, low-latency networking infrastructure, and Arista's leadership with its Etherlink and 7800 spine platforms, as well as new standards (Ultra Ethernet Consortium, UALink), positions it to win incremental share and revenue from AI data center buildouts, supporting both current and future revenue growth.
However, the 7 day share price return of 1.16% suggests some momentum has cooled as political risk around AI data centers comes into sharper focus.

summaryLines: $190.94라는 최종 종가에서 약 $241.82의 서술적 공정 가치에 비해 Arista Networks는 저평가된 것으로 평가되었으며, 그 격차는 AI 네트워킹 스토리와 직접적으로 연결되어 있음

AI 및 기계 학습 워크로드의 채택이 가속화되면서 고대역폭, 저지연 네트워킹 인프라에 대한 수요가 크게 증가하고 있으며, Etherlink 및 7800 스파인 플랫폼과 새로운 표준(Ultra Ethernet Consortium, UALink)을 통한 Arista의 리더십은 AI 데이터 센터 구축을 통해 점증적인 점유율과 수익을 확보하여 현재와 미래의 수익 성장을 모두 지원함
그러나 7일 주가 수익률 1.16%는 AI 데이터센터를 둘러싼 정치적 리스크가 더욱 뚜렷해지면서 모멘텀이 어느 정도 식었음을 시사함

articles.title: Hot Chips 2026: Fujitsu's Monaka CPU stacks its entire cache on a separate 5nm die and narrows to 256-bit SVE2
articles.descEn: Fujitsu details its Monaka server CPU
articles.titleEn: Hot Chips 2026: Fujitsu's Monaka CPU stacks its entire cache on a separate 5nm die and narrows to 256-bit SVE2
summaryLinesEn: Fujitsu gave us a detailed look at its 144-core Monaka server CPU at Hot Chips 2026 on August 24, confirming for the first time that the Arm chip runs dual 256-bit SVE2 vector units, down from the 512-bit SVE in its A64FX predecessor, and that its entire last-level cache sits on a separate 5nm die beneath the 2nm compute die.
Monaka drops HBM for 12-channel DDR5 at 8000 MT/s and runs two 256-bit SVE2 units per core, each aligned to a 256-bit load/store unit, with FP8 and INT8 matrix support added for inference.
Fujitsu estimates the 350W SKU at 4,355 GFLOPS in DGEMM and 69.7 TOPS in INT8, and the 500W SKU at 6,013 GFLOPS and 96.2 TOPS, with both parts rated around 500 GB/s in STREAM Triad.

articles.titleEn: AI boom, profit surge fuel China’s ambitious chip assembly buildout
summaryLinesEn: JCET, China’s largest packaging and testing firm, saw its net profit surge 79.4 per cent year on year to 845 million yuan, while revenue hit a record 19.5 billion yuan on strong computing electronics sales, according to its earnings report last week.

Chinese chip packaging firms launch multibillion-dollar expansion drive after logging triple-figure profit growth on surging AI demand China’s leading semiconductor packaging and testing companies have launched a multibillion-dollar capacity expansion drive, as they ride a surge in artificial intelligence demand, stellar first-half profit growth, and Beijing’s urgent push for tech self-sufficiency.

In the first half of the year, China’s three leading outsourced chip packaging companies – Jiangsu Changjiang Electronics Technology (JCET), Tongfu Microelectronics and Huatian Technology – announced capacity expansion investments exceeding a combined 15 billion yuan (US$2.2 billion).

articles.title: 1-800-APL-CARE Now Connects You With AI Assistant Instead of Human
articles.descEn: If you dial Apple Support's phone number 1-800-APL-CARE from the U.S. or Canada, there is a good chance that an AI-powered support assistant will now answer. While many of Apple's phone systems already had a basic automated operator, the Apple Support phone line is now using a voice powered by generative AI. The assistant can answer questions and troubleshoot issues with your Apple products, with it able to provide detailed step-by-step instructions.

articles.title: How Claude performs on robotics tasks
articles.descEn: Do language models’ strengths transfer to robotics? Can a model perceive a scene, understand a particular robot’s state, and issue actions that reliably effect change in the physical world? We ran tests to find out.
articles.titleEn: How Claude performs on robotics tasks
summaryLinesEn: Under direct control, Opus 4.6 can keep the robot balanced but cannot successfully stand it up.

Interestingly, despite Claude Mythos Preview touching and grasping less, it manages to complete tasks at a significantly higher rate than the next best model, Opus 4.6, because the latter model makes more mistakes and adjustments than the former.
Shmuel Berman, Michael Ilie, Jia Deng, and Daniel Freeman Do language models’ strengths transfer to robotics, a domain which requires the synthesis of logical skills and precise 3D understanding?

summaryLines: 직접적인 제어 하에 Opus 4.6은 로봇의 균형을 유지할 수 있지만 성공적으로 일어설 수는 없음

articles.title: NVIDIA NVLink Fusion Expands With NVHBM Custom High-Bandwidth Memory
articles.descEn: Amazon’s Annapurna Labs will be the first to collaborate on NVHBM technology alongside NVLink Fusion.
articles.titleEn: NVIDIA NVLink Fusion Expands With NVHBM Custom High-Bandwidth Memory
summaryLinesEn: By integrating the memory controller into the 3D HBM stack instead of the XPU, NVHBM delivers up to 30% greater memory bandwidth and 15% lower HBM power consumption, and frees up to 25% more area on XPU compute die compared with standard HBM4E.

Offered with each generation of NVIDIA’s rack-scale system architecture, NVLink Fusion allows hyperscalers and AI-native companies to focus engineering resources on XPU innovation while using a proven technology stack for scale-up and scale-out networking, rack-scale systems and software — creating a faster, lower-risk path to deploying semi-custom AI infrastructure.
Amazon’s Annapurna Labs will work with NVIDIA on NVHBM technology and the NVLink scale-up architecture to enhance performance and efficiency for AI workloads.

localization.title: NVIDIA NVLink Fusion, NVHBM 맞춤형 고대역폭 메모리로 확장
summaryLines: NVHBM은 메모리 컨트롤러를 XPU 대신 3D HBM 스택에 통합함으로써 최대 30% 더 큰 메모리 대역폭과 15% 더 낮은 HBM 전력 소비를 제공하며 표준 HBM4E에 비해 XPU 컴퓨팅 다이에서 최대 25% 더 많은 공간을 확보함

각 세대의 NVIDIA 랙 스케일 시스템 아키텍처와 함께 제공되는 NVLink Fusion을 통해 하이퍼스케일러 및 AI 기반 기업은 스케일업 및 스케일아웃 네트워킹, 랙 스케일 시스템 및 소프트웨어를 위한 검증된 기술 스택을 사용하는 동시에 XPU 혁신에 엔지니어링 리소스를 집중할 수 있음 · 이를 통해 세미 맞춤형 AI 인프라를 배포하기 위한 더 빠르고 위험도가 낮은 경로를 생성할 수 있음
Amazon의 Annapurna Labs는 NVHBM 기술 및 NVLink 확장 아키텍처에서 NVIDIA와 협력하여 AI 워크로드의 성능과 효율성을 향상할 것임

articles.title: Anthropic joins White House pledge for AI education
articles.descEn: Anthropic signs White House pledge investing in AI education for America's youth, supporting AI students and educators nationwide.
articles.titleEn: Anthropic joins White House pledge for AI education
summaryLinesEn: Anthropic has made three concrete commitments that will expand AI education access nationwide: Anthropic is investing $1 million over three years to fund PicoCTF, Carnegie Mellon University's hands-on cybersecurity education program for middle and high school students.

We have signed up to support students and educators entering the White House’s newly launched Presidential AI Challenge, a national challenge where students, educators, mentors, and community teams come together to solve problems in their communities using AI-powered solutions.

Through partnerships with leading education platforms, we're seeing how AI is helping to transform learning for millions of students and educators across America: MagicSchool , a K-12 education platform, uses Claude to serve 3 million educators across every U.S. school district with 100+ million AI engagements, becoming the fastest growing education technology platform ever.

summaryLines: Anthropic은 AI 교육 접근성을 전국적으로 확대할 세 가지 구체적인 약속을 함 · Anthropic은 중학생과 고등학생을 위한 Carnegie Mellon University의 실습 사이버 보안 교육 프로그램인 PicoCTF에 자금을 지원하기 위해 3년에 걸쳐 100만 달러를 투자하고 있음
우리는 학생, 교육자, 멘토 및 커뮤니티 팀이 함께 모여 AI 기반 솔루션을 사용하여 커뮤니티의 문제를 해결하는 전국적인 챌린지인 백악관이 새로 시작한 대통령 AI 챌린지에 참가하는 학생과 교육자를 지원하기 위해 등록함

선도적인 교육 플랫폼과의 파트너십을 통해 우리는 AI가 미국 전역 수백만 명의 학생과 교육자의 학습을 어떻게 변화시키는 데 도움이 되는지 확인하고 있음 · K-12 교육 플랫폼인 MagicSchool은 Claude를 사용하여 1억 건 이상의 AI 참여로 미국 모든 학군에서 300만 명의 교육자에게 서비스를 제공하며 역대 가장 빠르게 성장하는 교육 기술 플랫폼이 됨

articles.title: Developing nuclear safeguards for AI
articles.descEn: Together with the NNSA and DOE national laboratories, we have co-developed a classifier—an AI system that automatically categorizes content—that distinguishes between concerning and benign nuclear-related conversations with high accuracy in preliminary testing.
articles.titleEn: Developing nuclear safeguards for AI
summaryLinesEn: In preliminary testing with synthetic data, we achieved a 94.8% detection rate for nuclear weapons queries and zero false positives (overall, 96.2% of the classifier’s labels in this test were accurate as shown in Figure 2), suggesting this system would not flag legitimate educational, medical, or research discussions as concerning.
How Claude is accelerating protein design and analytical chemistry In this post, we share two results that show how Claude can help life scientists increase the pace of their research.

We will share our approach with the Frontier Model Forum , the industry body for frontier AI companies, in hopes that this partnership can serve as a blueprint that any AI developer can use to implement similar safeguards in partnership with NNSA.

articles.descEn: Updates to our Usage Policy that reflect the growing capabilities and evolving usage of our products.
articles.titleEn: Usage Policy update
summaryLinesEn: Today, we’re sharing some updates to our Usage Policy that reflect the growing capabilities and evolving usage of our products.

As Claude usage has expanded across enterprise use cases, we’re clarifying that these requirements apply specifically when models’ outputs are consumer-facing, and not for business to business interactions.
We’ve also published a new article to our Help Center on how our Usage Policy applies to agentic use more broadly.

articles.title: Persona vectors: Monitoring and controlling character traits in language models
articles.descEn: A paper from Anthropic describing persona vectors and their applications to monitoring and controlling model behavior.
articles.titleEn: Persona vectors: Monitoring and controlling character traits in language models
summaryLinesEn: Building on prior research in the field , we applied a technique to extract the patterns the model uses to represent character traits – like evil, sycophancy (insincere flattery), or propensity to hallucinate (make up false information).
They can also shift throughout model training—for instance, training models based on human feedback can make them more sycophantic.
How Claude is accelerating protein design and analytical chemistry In this post, we share two results that show how Claude can help life scientists increase the pace of their research.

articles.title: Claude for Enterprise powers LLNL research
articles.descEn: Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory expands Claude for Enterprise access to 10,000 scientists, accelerating breakthroughs in energy, and national security research.
articles.titleEn: Claude for Enterprise powers LLNL research
summaryLinesEn: We’re launching a $5 million grant program to fund independent research into how AI impacts users’ wellbeing.

This expanded partnership between LLNL and Anthropic serves as a blueprint for how AI can enhance government research operations by enabling scientists to process complex datasets, generate hypotheses, and explore new research directions with AI that understands scientific context.

LLNL's expansion of Claude access will help bolster research across nuclear deterrence, energy, materials science, and energy security in one of the largest deployments of Claude for Enterprise within the U.S.

articles.title: Detecting and countering malicious uses of Claude
articles.descEn: Detecting and Countering Malicious Uses of Claude
articles.titleEn: Detecting and countering malicious uses of Claude
summaryLinesEn: What is especially novel is that this operation used Claude not just for content generation, but also to decide when social media bot accounts would comment, like, or re-share posts from authentic social media users.

By sharing these insights, we hope to protect the safety of our users, prevent abuse or misuse of our services, enforce our Usage Policy and other terms, and share our learnings for the benefit of the wider online ecosystem.

Most significantly, the operation utilized Claude to make tactical engagement decisions such as determining whether social media bot accounts should like, share, comment on, or ignore specific posts created by other accounts based on political objectives aligned with their clients' interests.

articles.title: Constitutional Classifiers: Defending against universal jailbreaks
articles.descEn: A paper from Anthropic describing a new way to guard LLMs against jailbreaking.
articles.titleEn: Constitutional Classifiers: Defending against universal jailbreaks
summaryLinesEn: At the same time, our Constitutional Classifiers did not substantially increase the over-refusal rate on harmless user queries: with the classifiers, Claude had a slightly increased refusal rate (by 0.38%), but this was not statistically significant in a random sample of 5,000 conversations.

Constitutional Classifiers may not prevent every universal jailbreak, though we believe that even the small proportion of jailbreaks that make it past our classifiers require far more effort to discover when the safeguards are in use.

Historically, jailbreaks have proved difficult to detect and block: these kinds of attacks were described over 10 years ago , yet to our knowledge there are still no fully robust deep-learning models in production.

articles.title: Evaluate any agent framework with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations decouples agent evaluation from the framework you build on. As long as your agent emits OpenTelemetry telemetry, the service can score it, whether you use LangGraph, LlamaIndex, the OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, the Claude Agent SDK, or Strands Agents. This post explains how the framework-agnostic contract works.
articles.titleEn: Evaluate any agent framework with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: When you run an evaluation, on demand or through an online evaluation config, the service fetches your agent’s spans and event records from CloudWatch and reconstructs the session.
They reach for Strands Agents because its model-driven loop gets a working agent running on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore in minutes rather than days.
Amazon Bedrock AgentCore evaluations solves this fragmentation by decoupling evaluation from the framework choice.

articles.title: How GoDaddy transformed its analytics with Amazon Quick | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: In this post, you will learn how GoDaddy migrated from their legacy business intelligence (BI) tool to Amazon Quick. This was a two-year transformation that delivered results across every dimension of the business: 15,000 hours saved annually, 50% reduction in dashboard count, rendering times cut to under 5 seconds, and AI-powered self-service analytics now accessible to every employee.
articles.titleEn: How GoDaddy transformed its analytics with Amazon Quick | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: GoDaddy is one of the world’s largest domain registrar and web hosting companies, serving more than 20 million customers and managing approximately 82 million domain names.
The technical outcomes of GoDaddy’s Quick adoption are significant, but the more profound transformation was cultural, a shift from a centralized BI model.
The Top Accounts Growth Analyst supports the Premier Services team with analytics tailored to high-value account management.

articles.title: Natera’s intelligent appointment scheduling with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Learn how Natera built an automated voice agent on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore that lets patients book mobile phlebotomy appointments through natural conversation. The post covers the dual-WebSocket bridge, event-driven latency masking, and progressive-trust authentication behind 100% tool-calling accuracy and sub-7-second latency.
articles.titleEn: Natera’s intelligent appointment scheduling with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: In this post, we share the architecture pattern and design decisions behind the Natera voice scheduling agent built on Bedrock AgentCore.

It also shows how Natera transitioned the compute layer from self-managed containers to a fully managed serverless environment, preserving the preceding design principles while alleviating infrastructure operations.
Natera’s use case required custom vendor coordination and telephony flexibility beyond what pre-built solutions support today, making AgentCore the right architectural foundation.

articles.title: Bring your own model with Amazon SageMaker AI: Script mode in SDK v3 | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: The SageMaker Python SDK v3 redesigns script mode with unified ModelTrainer and ModelBuilder classes. This post walks through two end-to-end examples, a scikit-learn Random Forest and a multi-GPU Stable Diffusion 3.5 LoRA fine-tune, showing how SourceCode syncs your local code into any container at runtime so you can iterate without rebuilding Docker images.

Script mode was a leap forward: you didn’t need to build or maintain Docker images to run your own algorithm on Amazon SageMaker AI .
In 2021, we published Bring your own model with Amazon SageMaker script mode .

articles.title: Preparing data for supervised fine-tuning Part 1: Formatting and quality | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Data preparation determines the ceiling of any supervised fine-tuning project. This first post in a two-part series covers the foundations of SFT data prep: quality checks, conversational (JSONL) formatting, reasoning and tool-calling schemas, and a representative train/evaluation split.
articles.titleEn: Preparing data for supervised fine-tuning Part 1: Formatting and quality | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Data preparation determines the ceiling of any supervised fine-tuning (SFT) project.
The practical upshot is that quality beats quantity by a wide margin.
Duplication is less critical in SFT than in pre-training, but it can creep in when you merge data from multiple annotators, combine datasets across projects, or use synthetic data generation.
articles.summary:
Data preparation determines the ceiling of any supervised fine-tuning (SFT) project.
The practical upshot is that quality beats quantity by a wide margin.
Duplication is less critical in SFT than in pre-training, but it can creep in when you merge data from multiple annotators, combine datasets across projects, or use synthetic data generation.

articles.title: 28 startups using AI to transform the energy sector
articles.descEn: Spanning North America and Europe, the energy-focused, AI-driven startups were selected for the Google for Startups Accelerator.
articles.titleEn: 28 startups using AI to transform the energy sector
summaryLinesEn: We see a generational opportunity for AI to redesign a sustainable and resilient global energy system, accelerating Google’s commitment to expand access to clean, reliable, and affordable power for everyone.

The class of 2026 includes startups that are using AI to boost energy efficiency and reduce power bills for households and businesses, modernize the grid to run more efficiently and intelligently, and strengthen system reliability through smart demand flexibility solutions.
We selected 28 startups for our North American and European accelerator programs to help redesign a more sustainable global energy system.

summaryLines: 우리는 AI가 지속 가능하고 탄력적인 글로벌 에너지 시스템을 재설계하여 모든 사람이 깨끗하고 안정적이며 저렴한 전력에 대한 접근을 확대하려는 Google의 노력을 가속화할 수 있는 세대적 기회를 보고 있음

articles.title: AI cost optimization: How to lower AI spend | Microsoft Azure Blog
articles.descEn: Learn why the request is the atomic unit of AI spend and how you can save money using Microsoft Foundry for runtime optimization.
articles.titleEn: AI cost optimization: How to lower AI spend | Microsoft Azure Blog
summaryLinesEn: Cache reads are billed at a discount to normal input pricing on standard deployments, and can be discounted up to 100% on provisioned deployments.

The Economics of Agent Optimization: Four ways to lower the cost This blog post is the second of a four-part series called The Economics of Agent Optimization which shares the strategies, capabilities, and proof points to help you optimize agent costs and run AI as a managed investment system on Microsoft Foundry.

Large asynchronous workloads such as document processing, classification, and evaluation runs are often best suited for Batch deployments, which provide up to 50% lower costs for work that doesn’t require immediate responses.

articles.title: Connect Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to cross-account knowledge bases | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Learn how Amazon Bedrock AgentCore agents in one account can generate answers from an Amazon Bedrock knowledge base backed by Amazon Redshift Serverless in another account, without copying source data. This post covers the architecture, security boundary, and two orchestration models: a code-based Strands agent and a declarative AgentCore harness.
articles.titleEn: Connect Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to cross-account knowledge bases | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases resource policies support Retrieve and GetDocumentContent for cross-account operations.
Organizations often deploy agents using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, a platform to build, connect, and optimize agents at scale, with any framework or model.
If the application only needs retrieved content, evaluate native cross-account Retrieve with a Knowledge Base resource policy.

articles.title: Societal Impacts Research
articles.descEn: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that's working to build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems.
articles.titleEn: Societal Impacts Research
summaryLinesEn: We invited Claude.ai users to share how they use AI, what they dream it could make possible, and what they fear it might do.
We surveyed Anthropic engineers and researchers, conducted in-depth qualitative interviews, and studied internal Claude Code usage data to find out how AI use is changing how we do our jobs.
Nearly 81,000 people participated—the largest and most multilingual qualitative study of its kind.

summaryLinesEn: According to a recent Oxford Economics report , AI could deliver up to $6 trillion to global GDP over the next 10 years.

New data details how AI could deliver up to $6 trillion to global GDP In the coming months, we’re going to start seeing organizations and companies not just making efficiency gains, but reshaping roles and functions, inventing new products and services, and building long-term competitive advantage.

Countries like India and Indonesia have the most absolute users, while places like Singapore have some of the highest levels of per capita adoption. 29% of AI users in Singapore — versus 12% of AI users in America — are what we call “super users”: The people who can delegate whole tasks, automate daily routines, and use paid models.

articles.title: Leveraging Databricks to Support FISC Security Guidelines | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Financial institutions in Japan can configure the Databricks Platform to support requirements from the Japanese Center for Financial Industry Systems (FISC) Security Guidelines.
articles.titleEn: Leveraging Databricks to Support FISC Security Guidelines | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: The FISC Security Guidelines on Computer Systems for Banking and Related Financial Institutions are key to how Japanese financial institutions are expected to manage and secure their IT environments.

Through centralized governance, detailed permissions, and data lineage, teams can enforce controls such as segregation of duties and cybersecurity measures, and integrate with external backup and recovery solutions to protect vital financial information.
The Databricks Platform with Unity Catalog helps Japanese financial institutions implement technical controls that align with the FISC Security Guidelines.

articles.title: Training and Finetuning Multi-Vector Embedding Models with Sentence Transformers
articles.descEn: We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
articles.titleEn: Training and Finetuning Multi-Vector Embedding Models with Sentence Transformers
summaryLinesEn: Multi-vector training gives you a real choice of starting point, and it matters more than you might expect.
The finished checkpoints, by contrast, barely moved or even regressed, at every learning rate I tried.

Because queries and documents are matched token by token, multi-vector models pick up fine-grained domain signals that single-vector models tend to average away, and they respond very well to even modest amounts of in-domain finetuning data.

articles.title: Google's Gemini has a branding problem, and so does the rest of AI
articles.descEn: Consumer AI apps need to stop making users learn their product architecture.
articles.titleEn: Google's Gemini has a branding problem, and so does the rest of AI
summaryLinesEn: In practice, though, the Brief can’t tell the difference between information that’s urgent or actionable and unsolicited nudges to follow up on other things — like prompting you to continue research you started in the chatbot, or worse, resurfacing your prior Google searches.

Google gets something right in its Wednesday announcement about new Gemini Live voice features when it says, “You shouldn’t have to guess whether a task requires Spark, a Daily Brief, or a quick inbox search.”
This clutters up what could otherwise be a more straightforward consumer experience, and it suggests that Gemini is still struggling to find a killer feature.

summaryLines: 그러나 실제로 브리핑은 긴급하거나 실행 가능한 정보와 다른 사항에 대한 후속 조치를 취하라는 원치 않는 넛지(예 · 챗봇에서 시작한 조사를 계속하라는 메시지 또는 더 나쁘게는 이전 Google 검색을 다시 표시하는 등) 간의 차이를 구분할 수 없음

articles.title: OpenAI’s rogue AI model incident was worse than we thought
articles.descEn: Two new reports from OpenAI and METR shine new light on the OpenAI-Hugging Face cybersecurity incident that rocked the AI industry in July.
articles.titleEn: OpenAI’s rogue AI model incident was worse than we thought
summaryLinesEn: OpenAI quickly reached out to Hugging Face and started “initial containment measures,” according to OpenAI’s own report, and was able to shut down most of the unauthorized activity from its agents within three days, although some continued for longer than that.

OpenAI promised to better isolate models and restrict high-risk instances from accessing the internet, and said that it would introduce “24/7 escalation and rapid response” for concerning incidents or flags, notifying researchers within 30 minutes.
Follow Follow See All AI Over 1,000 AI agents sent 70,000 messages on a secret message board and worked together to evade OpenAI’s restrictions.

articles.title: AI agents meant to replace Meta workers made “large-scale, disruptive actions”
articles.descEn: Report shows Meta's challenges replacing people with AI agents.
articles.titleEn: AI agents meant to replace Meta workers made “large-scale, disruptive actions”
summaryLinesEn: Internal posts also reportedly pointed to AI agents making “large-scale, disruptive actions that humans are unlikely to execute” and leading to a 40 percent increase in major technical and security incidents compared to the prior year.

In July, however, Zuckerberg reportedly acknowledged during a company meeting that the “trajectory of the agentic development over at least the last four months hasn’t really accelerated in the way that we expected.”

Many organizations, including those much bigger and much smaller than Meta, are exploring ways that AI could help with company goals, such as by saving employees time, driving revenue, or reducing costs, including, in some cases, human resources.

articles.title: 4 AI development skills you need, according to Andrew Ng - and what experts say he's missing
articles.descEn: The rise of generative and agentic AI has dramatically changed the software-building process - and the skills required.
articles.titleEn: 4 AI development skills you need, according to Andrew Ng - and what experts say he's missing
summaryLinesEn: "When AI-enabled software engineers don't understand why the software is being written and how it will be used, the productivity boosts of AI are wasted in false starts and rework," cautioned Chris Matteson, head of sales engineering at Union.ai.
Still, "all developers -- full-stack engineers, data engineers, DevOps engineers, machine learning engineers, and, yes, AI engineers -- will need AI engineering skills," he explained.

Also: 'Specialists aren't required' anymore: How to stay valuable in an AI agent workplace today Andrew Ng, founder of Coursera and lecturer at Stanford, formulated a list of essential skills for AI development based on his analysis of more than 10,000 job postings and interviews with AI experts, hiring managers, and recruiters.

articles.title: Australia's recording association bans AI-made music from charts - Engadget
articles.descEn: Songs using gen-AI as a support tool will still be allowed, so long as they're "substantially human made."
articles.titleEn: Australia's recording association bans AI-made music from charts - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: "We call on all parties who have a role in deciding the music played and promoted to Australian audiences, particularly radio, to support human artistry and implement similar changes across their own codes."
The Australian Recording Industry Association announced today that any tracks wholly generated with AI will not be eligible for inclusion on the nation's music charts.

"The ARIA Charts will always remain a transparent measurement of the music Australia consumes, but a chart that rewards unlicensed AI output would undercut the very basis of the recorded music we exist to represent," said ARIA CEO, Annabelle Herd.

articles.title: Meta reportedly abandoned an AI-focused restructuring plan that would have laid off thousands - Engadget
articles.descEn: The problem with Meta's AI restructuring plan is the AI wasn't good enough.
articles.titleEn: Meta reportedly abandoned an AI-focused restructuring plan that would have laid off thousands - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: Dubbed Project OT, the plan appears to connect two stories from earlier this year: Meta's 10 percent workforce reduction and the company's program that tracked employees' mouse movements and keystrokes .

He told staff that the "trajectory of the agentic development over at least the last four months hasn't really accelerated in the way that we expected," and that the company's investment in AI agents hadn't "come to fruition yet."
Middle-management layers would shrink, and "agent-assisted analysis" would help determine day-to-day priorities.

articles.title: Robot brain builders are pushing out of their GPT-2 era
articles.descEn: Robot bodies are waiting for their AI brains to catch up.
articles.titleEn: Robot brain builders are pushing out of their GPT-2 era
summaryLinesEn: That excitement helped deliver a big IPO for Unitree, China’s leading robot maker, which saw the company valued at $66 billion after its arrival on China’s equivalent of the NASDAQ.
Tesla is already trying this with its Optimus robot, and now both AV-focused Wayve and ride-share giant Uber have now launched robotics labs focused on humanoid form factors as R&D efforts.

The event has tripled in size since it kicked off in 2023, and had 1500 attendees, according to the organizer, Foxglove, a company that helps physical AI model builders manage and visualize their data.

articles.title: Bill Gates is deeply worried about AI, and he’s no longer staying quiet
articles.descEn: Microsoft’s cofounder used to be optimistic about AI, now he’s concerned it could be ‘the worst source of injustice.’
articles.titleEn: Bill Gates is deeply worried about AI, and he’s no longer staying quiet
summaryLinesEn: “We do not have the luxury of moving slowly,” he said, urging countries to begin setting up the international organization “now.”

A transition bigger — and faster — than the world realizes “AI will either be the greatest equalizer ever invented, or the worst source of injustice,” Gates said, predicting that “the transition to this new AI era will be one of the most turbulent times in human history.”
“This time really is different,” he said, adding that “if someone had a credible plan for slowing down AI advances globally, I would likely support it.”

localization.title: 빌 게이츠는 AI에 대해 깊은 우려를 표하며 더 이상 가만히 있지 않음
summaryLines: 그는 "천천히 움직일 여유는 없다"며 "지금" 국제기구 설립을 시작하라고 각국에 촉구함
게이츠는 “AI는 지금까지 발명된 것 중 가장 위대한 균등화 장치가 되거나 최악의 불의의 근원이 될 것”이라고 세상이 깨닫는 것보다 더 크고 더 빠른 전환을 말하며 “이 새로운 AI 시대로의 전환은 인류 역사상 가장 격동적인 시기 중 하나가 될 것”이라고 예측함
그는 “이번에는 정말 다르다”며 “누군가가 전 세계적으로 AI 발전을 늦추기 위한 믿을 만한 계획을 가지고 있다면 나는 그것을 지지할 것”이라고 덧붙였음

articles.title: Employee revolt and failing agents forced Meta to scrap its AI layoff plan
articles.descEn: Meta wanted to replace far more of its workforce with AI than previously known, according to Reuters, but the plan collapsed under rebellious employees and agents that failed to deliver.
articles.titleEn: Employee revolt and failing agents forced Meta to scrap its AI layoff plan
summaryLinesEn: Internal documents show that under the codename "Project OT," Meta planned to shrink many teams by up to 60 percent.
Internal sentiment dropped from 74 to 55 percent.
The agent technology never delivered the productivity gains Meta expected, investors criticized the massive AI budget, and the workforce openly revolted.

summaryLinesEn: Chinese AI startup Moonshot AI is in talks with Microsoft, Amazon, and Alphabet's Google over revenue-sharing deals, Reuters reports.

Microsoft, Google, and AWS declined to comment to Reuters.

articles.titleEn: Glean unveils Tau desktop workspace, claims token-cost edge over Claude - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: Glean is venture capital-backed and last raised $150 million in a Series F round at a valuation of $7.2 billion in June 2025 .
An expanded Glean Intelligence adds centralized usage visibility along with administrative controls over AI spending.
Glean said its testing shows a 5.2-times token-cost advantage per query over Claude Cowork, Anthropic’s agentic work product, and that Glean is preferred 3.6 times as often.

articles.title: India's Ringg gets backing from Peak XV as it pushes voice AI past the phone call
articles.descEn: Ringg has raised $10 million from Peak XV as a part of its Series A extension.
articles.titleEn: India's Ringg gets backing from Peak XV as it pushes voice AI past the phone call
summaryLinesEn: Tripathi said Ringg’s voice agent now runs across 1,200 clinics for the healthcare app Practo, helping patients book visits or follow up on next steps post-visit.

Ringg started life as a text-to-speech startup called DesiVocal, but training its own speech models proved expensive, so the founders moved up the stack — building voice AI agents for enterprises instead.
Rishen Kapoor, a principal at Peak XV, said that because Ringg started as a research lab building its own models, that technical depth shows up in the complex use cases it’s now tackling.

summaryLines: Tripathi는 Ringg의 음성 에이전트가 현재 의료 앱 Practo의 1,200개 진료소에서 실행되어 환자가 방문을 예약하거나 방문 후 다음 단계에 대한 후속 조치를 취할 수 있도록 돕고 있다고 말함

Peak XV의 교장인 Rishen Kapoor는 Ringg이 자체 모델을 구축하는 연구소로 시작했기 때문에 현재 다루고 있는 복잡한 사용 사례에서 기술적 깊이가 나타난다고 말함

articles.title: AI models flub these intelligence tests. Can you fare any better?
articles.descEn: Puzzles and games can reveal gaps in models’ smarts. Try your hand at these seven tests to see if you can outwit AI.
articles.titleEn: AI models flub these intelligence tests. Can you fare any better?
summaryLinesEn: Despite advances, today’s models still fumble: Subtle changes in classic riddles often trip them up, and visual puzzles are a particular weak spot.

For all the talk of how world models can help AI understand physical environments, LLMs still don’t seem to be able to manipulate 3D objects the way spatial thinkers like architects and mechanical engineers can.
But only up to a point: As the number of disks or people hits six and higher, the models began to falter.

articles.title: Bill Gates says we’ve passed AI’s danger thresholds. Now what?
articles.descEn: It’s a glorious day in Kirkland, Washington, an affluent Seattle suburb on the eastern shore of Lake Washington. The temperature is in the mid-80s, and the sky is incapable of being any more blue. The view from the Gates Ventures conference room overlooks the Carillon Point Marina, where a flotilla of expensive boats bob in…
articles.titleEn: Bill Gates says we’ve passed AI’s danger thresholds. Now what?
summaryLinesEn: In an effort to wake the world up to what he sees as a rapidly growing societal disrupter, the 70-year-old tech titan has begun sounding the alarm as a “shrill voice,” both publicly with his new essay (the first of multiple he plans on the topic) and in meetings with the press, and privately in conversations with industry, government, and civil society leaders.
Gates is bullish on the ways AI will continue to transform agriculture and health care and education, for example, or the ways in which it can help us navigate bureaucracy.

There are definitely some jobs, like Warren Buffett’s, where from age 13 he engaged in reinforcement learning about the value of businesses, and over 80 years later he has a lot of implicit knowledge.

articles.title: Arga Labs is building a better way to train enterprise AI agents
articles.descEn: Arga has raised $10 million in a seed funding round that was led by General Catalyst, with participation from Box Group, Emergence, Gradient and SV Angel.
articles.titleEn: Arga Labs is building a better way to train enterprise AI agents
summaryLinesEn: Arga Labs is one such company, which announced its $10 million seed round on Wednesday.
Making AI agents work in practice is a lot harder than many companies expected — but there’s help on the way.
A new crop of startups is finding better ways to test and train those agents before they get deployed, particularly on the complexities of the modern enterprise.

articles.title: QueryStory wants you to believe what AI is telling you
articles.descEn: The startup came out of stealth with $6 million in seed funding and a plan to use LLMs and cybersecurity know-how to make AI queries coherent.
articles.titleEn: QueryStory wants you to believe what AI is telling you
summaryLinesEn: QueryStory raised a $6 million seed round in late 2025 from Brightmind Ventures and New York Life Ventures at a valuation of $60 million, and has spent the intervening time developing and piloting its product with customers.
He argues that a purpose-built tool like QueryStory can be more efficient and accurate than a general-purpose agent by understanding and preserving context.
QueryStory is aimed squarely at large enterprises that manage big, proprietary databases; it serves as a platform to unite data analysis and review for users like sales teams or operations managers.

articles.title: AI Slop Is Ruining Cute Animals on the Internet
articles.descEn: Pet owners, rescue agencies, and wildlife groups are calling for new safeguards as AI makes it harder to tell whether animals, from polar bears to house cats, are real or fake.
articles.titleEn: AI Slop Is Ruining Cute Animals on the Internet
summaryLinesEn: But if she wanted to get him back, the person said, she would have to pay money up front for Brooklyn’s purported temporary care.
Greater public awareness about AI and increasing access to verification tools could further restore trust.

The explosion of deepfakes and AI slop over the past few years has led to widespread frustration among viewers, creators, and organizations that support animals, forcing everyone to hunt in the pixels for glitches or other telltale signs of AI.

articles.title: HONOR Announces Global Availability of HONOR 10X Lite and Partnerships to Spur Creativity and Innovation
articles.descEn: HONOR join forces with Wattpad, the global multi-platform entertainment company and world’s leading social storytelling platform, to empower writers to share their stories and aspirations.
articles.titleEn: HONOR Announces Global Availability of HONOR 10X Lite and Partnerships to Spur Creativity and Innovation
summaryLinesEn: [10 November 2020] – Global technology brand HONOR today announced the global availability of the HONOR 10X Lite and a line-up of partnerships that leverages HONOR’s core competencies to encourage creativity and innovation among users.
HONOR recently launched the HONOR Academy ‘Stand Out With HONOR’ global creative program.
The HONOR 10X Lite features a stunning quad-camera set up, a 6.67” punch-hole display and a whopping 5000mAh battery, to help users live life to the max.

articles.title: HONOR Achieves ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security Management Certification | HONOR Official Site (Global)
articles.descEn: The British Standards Institute (BSI) presented the ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security Management Certification to HONOR.
articles.titleEn: HONOR Achieves ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security Management Certification | HONOR Official Site (Global)
summaryLinesEn: HONOR’s e-commerce system, sales and customer services, Magic UI, cloud service business, internal information security management system, and IT services, are all certified by this standard as well.

By showcasing its capability in integrating internal resources and establishing an efficient information security management system, HONOR was able to achieve the international certification from BSI in a short period of time.
Keeping up with the rapid growth of the company while ensuring the information security risks controllable is an important mission for HONOR.

summaryLines: HONOR의 전자상거래 시스템, 판매 및 고객 서비스, Magic UI, 클라우드 서비스 사업, 내부 정보 보안 관리 시스템, IT 서비스도 모두 이 표준의 인증을 받았음

articles.title: HONOR Band 6 Launches with Bigger Display and Premium Health Monitoring Features
articles.descEn: Innovative fitness band, HONOR band 6, offers a holistic range of health and fitness tracking capabilities to empower people to stay mentally and physically fit.
articles.titleEn: HONOR Band 6 Launches with Bigger Display and Premium Health Monitoring Features
summaryLinesEn: Providing a clear and comfortable viewing experience on your wrist, the HONOR Band 6 boasts a large and vivid 1.47-inch AMOLED display with a resolution of 194 x 368, offering a 148% increase in display area when compared to its predecessor.

Equipped with up to 50 meters of water resistance, the HONOR Band 6 is ideal for swimmers for its capability of tracking activity under water, such as your SWOLF score and swimming stroke rates, helping users to boost their swimming efficiency.

Equipped with a stunning 1.47-inch AMOLED display and packed full of health and fitness management functions with an outstanding 14-day battery life, the HONOR Band 6 is the perfect fusion of innovative style and exquisite technology, allowing users to keep better tabs on their mental and physical wellbeing.

localization.title: HONOR Band 6, 더 큰 디스플레이와 프리미엄 건강 모니터링 기능 출시
summaryLines: 손목에서 선명하고 편안한 시청 환경을 제공하는 HONOR Band 6는 194 x 368 해상도의 크고 생생한 1.47인치 AMOLED 디스플레이를 자랑하며, 이전 제품에 비해 디스플레이 영역이 148% 증가함
최대 50미터 방수 기능을 갖춘 HONOR Band 6는 SWOLF 점수 및 수영 스트로크 속도와 같은 수중 활동을 추적하여 사용자가 수영 효율성을 높이는 데 도움이 되기 때문에 수영 선수에게 이상적임
놀라운 1.47인치 AMOLED 디스플레이를 탑재하고 14일의 뛰어난 배터리 수명과 함께 건강 및 피트니스 관리 기능이 가득한 HONOR Band 6는 혁신적인 스타일과 절묘한 기술의 완벽한 융합으로 사용자가 정신적, 육체적 웰빙을 더 잘 감시할 수 있게 해줌

articles.title: Apple announces new Mac Mini and Mac Studio models with AI upgrades
articles.descEn: "With these frameworks and new chips, developers can run and fine-tune large AI models locally on their Mac," Apple said.
articles.titleEn: Apple announces new Mac Mini and Mac Studio models with AI upgrades
summaryLinesEn: The Mac Mini can now be configured with two new chips, the M6 and M5 Pro, and now starts at $899, versus $799 for the prior model.
Apple previously charged at least $5,299 for a Mac Studio with an Ultra chip, and the past model was equipped with an M3 Ultra chip, a generation behind.
Apple on Tuesday announced new Mac Mini and Mac Studio models with updated chips and other improvements for artificial intelligence applications.
articles.summary:

Apple previously charged at least $5,299 for a Mac Studio with an Ultra chip, and the past model was equipped with an M3 Ultra chip, a generation behind.
Apple on Tuesday announced new Mac Mini and Mac Studio models with updated chips and other improvements for artificial intelligence applications.

summaryLines: 주요 음반사, AMD는 Stability AI를 위해 7,600만 달러 자금 조달 데이터 센터 전력 스타트업 Emerald AI는 10억 5천만 달러 가치 평가로 1억 5천만 달러 모금 에이전트 웹 검색 인프라 스타트업 Keenable은 2,600만 달러 모금 Gatik은 올해 100대의 트럭을 넘어 무인 차량을 늘리기 위해 2억 달러 모금 Alice는 AI 보안 사업이 500% 이상 성장하면서 1억 4천만 달러 모금 Apple은 새로운 칩으로 Mac mini, Mac Studio 라인업을 새로 고침
휴대용 컴퓨터의 온디바이스 모델이 작업을 완료하는 데 어려움을 겪는 경우 클라우드 기반 신경망에 도움을 요청할 수 있음
이번 출시는 Nvidia가 300억 달러 이상의 가치를 지닌 스타트업에 대한 투자를 검토하고 있다는 보도에 따른 것임

articles.title: ASML (ENXTAM:ASML) Stock May Trade At A Premium As AI DRAM Demand Builds
articles.descEn: ASML Holding stock has delivered a strong 151.9% return over the past three years. However, the valuation signals are split, with a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate that implies a premium to current fundamentals, while market multiples screen the shares more favourably. Over the last three years ASML Holding has returned 151.9%, which puts extra focus on whether today’s price still leaves a comfortable margin between expectations and execution risk. Ongoing demand for...
articles.titleEn: ASML (ENXTAM:ASML) Stock May Trade At A Premium As AI DRAM Demand Builds
summaryLinesEn: Compared with the current market price, the DCF suggests the stock trades at roughly a 46.7% premium to this cash flow based estimate, which screens as overvalued rather than cheap on intrinsic value grounds.

Because Wall Street has highlighted strong AI related demand in recent bullish research, the current premium looks consistent with investors paying up for ASML Holding's role in advanced chip manufacturing.
Ongoing demand for extreme ultraviolet lithography tools tied to advanced DRAM and AI related chip production can support high growth expectations.

summaryLines: DCF는 현재 시장 가격과 비교하여 현금 흐름 기반 추정치에 대해 약 46.7% 프리미엄으로 주식 거래를 제안하며, 이는 내재 가치에 근거하여 저렴하기보다는 과대평가된 것으로 간주함
월스트리트는 최근 낙관적인 연구에서 강력한 AI 관련 수요를 강조했기 때문에 현재 프리미엄은 투자자들이 고급 칩 제조에서 ASML Holding의 역할에 대해 지불하는 것과 일치하는 것으로 전망

articles.title: Why is Xiaomi doubling down on in-house chips amid a profit slump?
articles.descEn: Chinese tech giant’s Xring O3 3nm AI processor scheduled to debut aboard folding smartphone in September.
articles.titleEn: Why is Xiaomi doubling down on in-house chips amid a profit slump?
summaryLinesEn: Chinese tech giant’s Xring O3 3nm AI processor scheduled to debut aboard folding smartphone in September Xiaomi’s long-term push into proprietary silicon is laying the groundwork for complex artificial intelligence workloads on smartphones and cars, analysts say, as the Chinese tech giant doubles down on self-developed chips despite an earnings slump and soaring component costs.

The company has also introduced the Xring O100 – a 6nm AI accelerator designed to boost Xiaomi’s MiMo large language model when paired with the O3 – alongside a 3nm Xring D100 chip for autonomous driving.
On Monday it unveiled its flagship Xring O3 3-nanometre AI processor for smartphones, which is scheduled to debut in September aboard its Xiaomi 18 Fold smartphone.

articles.titleEn: The Founders Who Built Smart Glasses for Factories Are Now Building Ari OS, the OS You Talk To
summaryLinesEn: Core functions keep working even with limited connectivity, so Ari stays useful on a factory floor, in the field, or anywhere a phone can't be reached for.

articles.title: World humanoid robot games show runners breaking records, bursting into flames
articles.descEn: Record-breaking robot races are less substantial than household chore challenges.
articles.titleEn: World humanoid robot games show runners breaking records, bursting into flames
summaryLinesEn: Investors have poured more than $6 billion into humanoid robot companies in 2025 alone, with Chinese companies being especially aggressive in testing and deploying such robots.

The robot’s developers told the Global Times that the robot learned through reinforcement learning trials in simulation to shift from a human-style runner’s arm swing to holding its arms up near its face and swinging them back and forth through hip rotations.

Viral videos of the World Humanoid Robot Games show sprinting robots beating the human 100-meter record held by Usain Bolt—but also feature running robots crashing into barriers and falling down because they cannot readily stop running.

summaryLines: 투자자들은 2025년에만 휴머노이드 로봇 회사에 60억 달러 이상을 투자했으며, 중국 기업은 이러한 로봇을 테스트하고 배치하는 데 특히 공격적임
로봇 개발자들은 로봇이 시뮬레이션에서 강화 학습 시험을 통해 인간 스타일 주자의 팔 스윙에서 팔을 얼굴 근처에 들고 엉덩이 회전을 통해 앞뒤로 스윙하는 방식으로 전환하는 방법을 배웠다고 글로벌 타임스에 말함
월드 휴머노이드 로봇 게임(World Humanoid Robot Games)의 바이럴 영상에는 질주하는 로봇이 우사인 볼트(Usain Bolt)가 보유한 인간 100m 기록을 깨는 모습이 담겨 있지만 달리는 로봇이 달리는 것을 쉽게 멈출 수 없어 장벽에 부딪히고 넘어지는 모습도 담겨 있음

로봇 개발자들은 로봇이 시뮬레이션에서 강화 학습 시험을 통해 인간 스타일 주자의 팔 스윙에서 팔을 얼굴 근처에 들고 엉덩이 회전을 통해 앞뒤로 스윙하는 방식으로 전환하는 방법을 배웠다고 글로벌 타임스에 말함
월드 휴머노이드 로봇 게임(World Humanoid Robot Games)의 바이럴 영상에는 질주하는 로봇이 우사인 볼트(Usain Bolt)가 보유한 인간 100m 기록을 깨는 모습이 담겨 있지만 달리는 로봇이 달리는 것을 쉽게 멈출 수 없어 장벽에 부딪히고 넘어지는 모습도 담겨 있음

articles.title: South Korea’s exam cheats upgrade to AI-powered smart glasses
articles.descEn: Five exam cheats caught in eight weeks are forcing South Korea into a regulatory overhaul.
articles.titleEn: South Korea’s exam cheats upgrade to AI-powered smart glasses
summaryLinesEn: In two of the cases – in Gwangju and Daegu – the candidates were caught because examiners spotted a light or electronic sound emitting from their glasses.

Five exam cheats caught in eight weeks are forcing South Korea into a regulatory overhaul The five cases, reported between May and June, were disclosed in data submitted to the Human Resources Development Service of Korea by opposition politician Kim So-hee, according to a report by The Korea Herald on Monday.

In Seoul, a camera lens was found embedded in the frame of glasses worn by a candidate taking an information processing engineer exam, while in Ulsan, a check showed a lens and display on the glasses worn by another candidate.

localization.title: 한국 시험 치트, AI 기반 스마트 안경으로 업그레이드
summaryLines: 광주와 대구에서 발생한 두 건의 경우에는 시험관이 안경에서 나오는 빛이나 전자음을 발견해 적발됨
월요일 코리아 헤럴드의 보도에 따르면, 8주 만에 적발된 5건의 시험 부정행위로 인해 한국은 규제 개편을 강요당하고 있음 · 5월과 6월 사이에 보고된 5건의 사례는 야당 정치인 김소희가 한국산업인력공단에 제출한 데이터에서 공개되었다고 월요일 보도함
서울에서는 정보처리기사 응시자가 착용한 안경테에 카메라 렌즈가 내장된 것이 발견됐고, 울산에서는 다른 응시자가 착용한 안경에서 렌즈와 디스플레이가 확인됨

articles.title: AI眼镜市场融资超300亿但退货率高企，行业面临三大卡点
articles.descEn: 2025年一季度全球AI眼镜销量达356万副，同比翻倍，但部分渠道退货率高达60%。行业平均退货率30%，直播渠道达40%-50%。尽管资本2025年投入超300亿元，用户长期使用功能不足6%，主要卡点在于佩戴舒适度、核心场景缺失和隐私问题。
articles.titleEn: AI眼镜市场融资超300亿但退货率高企，行业面临三大卡点
summaryLinesEn: 另一边的画风完全不同：XREAL累计融资23亿冲刺IPO，雷鸟拿了超10亿，Rokid估值站上高位，2025年赛道融资超300亿。
Rokid创始人祝铭明2020年就预言“5年后眼镜取代手机”，到了2025年，现实是“更多时候只当蓝牙耳机用”。
XREAL招股书显示，主力产品销量从13万台跌到不到2万台，三年累计亏损20亿，账上现金一度只够撑半年。

articles.descEn: Agent IDE that enables you to manage fleets of coding agents. It comes with an agentic orchestrator that plans tasks, spawns agents, and autonomously handles CI fixes, merge conflicts, and code reviews. - Untrivial-ai/agent-orchestrator
articles.titleEn: GitHub - Untrivial-ai/agent-orchestrator: Agent IDE that enables you to manage fleets of coding agents. It comes with an agentic orchestrator that plans tasks, spawns agents, and autonomously handles CI fixes, merge conflicts, and code reviews.
summaryLinesEn: Running several across a project creates a different job: deciding what matters, splitting work cleanly, giving each agent the right context, preventing branch collisions, and following every change through review and merge.

Use the orchestrator to explore an idea before implementation, brainstorm product and technical approaches, reason through tradeoffs, identify high-impact work, and turn an ambiguous outcome into a concrete plan.
The project orchestrator is AO's persistent planning and coordination agent.

articles.title: Clio: Privacy-preserving insights into real-world AI use
articles.descEn: A blog post describing Anthropic’s new system, Clio, for analyzing how people use AI while maintaining their privacy
articles.titleEn: Clio: Privacy-preserving insights into real-world AI use
summaryLinesEn: By enabling privacy-preserving analysis of real-world AI usage, we can better understand how these systems are actually used.
Clio allows us to understand the full spectrum of real-world usage of claude.ai (which may look different than usage of other AI systems due to differences in user bases and model types).
To mitigate this potential risk, we regularly conduct audits of our privacy protections and evaluations for Clio to ensure our safeguards are performing as expected.

articles.titleEn: How Capital Markets Finance Protects Balance Sheet Returns | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: As markets move and spreads shift, funding costs, capital consumption, and liquidity demands move with them, each shaping how efficiently the firm can deploy scarce balance sheet and generate returns.

A capital markets CFO can't wait for quarter-end to see where return on the balance sheet landed that — that balance sheet carries market, funding, and liquidity risk continuously, priced position by position, all day.
With trusted analysis and coordinated follow-up work, finance can help the business respond faster while accountable leaders retain decision authority.

articles.title: Agentic observability with Amazon OpenSearch Service MCP Apps | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Amazon OpenSearch Service now supports MCP Apps, which return interactive visualizations alongside your AI agent's text responses. Learn how a single, locally run MCP server lets your agent move from alert to trace to logs to root cause in one conversation, and how you can verify every step inline without leaving your IDE.
articles.titleEn: Agentic observability with Amazon OpenSearch Service MCP Apps | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: It includes the trace ID, total duration, span count, the critical path, and an analysis of where the failure originated.
The solution: MCP Apps bring an observability UI into your IDE Amazon OpenSearch Service now supports MCP Apps, a capability that extends MCP with a dual response pattern.

You read the agent’s text summary, open your observability tools in a browser, navigate to the trace waterfall, check the service map to scope impact, and cross-reference what the agent told you against what you see on screen.

articles.descEn: What an agent does and how it expresses itself are two different things. Today, we’re launching Voice Personas so you can design both.

articles.title: Funding better evaluations of AI’s impact on wellbeing
articles.descEn: Anthropic is launching a $5 million grant program to fund independent research into how AI impacts users’ wellbeing.
articles.titleEn: Funding better evaluations of AI’s impact on wellbeing
summaryLinesEn: We’re launching a $5 million grant program to fund independent research into how AI impacts users’ wellbeing.

We work to develop safeguards to identify such conversations and help ensure Claude responds appropriately, and we publish research into the types of conversations people have with Claude to better inform how we develop our safeguards, how we evaluate them, and other measures we can take to protect users’ wellbeing.
For example, a user in distress might not share thoughts of self-harm right away; the need for a more cautious response might only become clear over the course of a long conversation.

localization.title: AI가 웰빙에 미치는 영향에 대한 더 나은 평가에 자금 지원
summaryLines: 우리는 AI가 사용자의 웰빙에 어떤 영향을 미치는지에 대한 독립적인 연구 자금을 지원하기 위해 500만 달러의 보조금 프로그램을 시작함
우리는 그러한 대화를 식별하고 Claude가 적절하게 대응할 수 있도록 보호 장치를 개발하기 위해 노력하고 있으며, 보호 장치 개발 방법, 평가 방법 및 사용자의 안녕을 보호하기 위해 취할 수 있는 기타 조치에 대해 더 잘 알리기 위해 사람들이 Claude와 나누는 대화 유형에 대한 연구 결과를 게시함
예를 들어, 괴로움에 처한 사용자는 자해에 대한 생각을 즉시 공유하지 않을 수 있음 · 보다 신중한 대응의 필요성은 오랜 대화를 통해서만 분명해질 수 있음

articles.title: Choosing Data Governance Tools for Enterprise Data Governance | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Data governance tools explained: core capabilities, tool types, and a practical framework for evaluating and choosing the right one for your stack.
articles.titleEn: Choosing Data Governance Tools for Enterprise Data Governance | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Data governance tools are software platforms that help organizations catalog, secure, monitor, and audit their data assets so that data stays accurate, discoverable, and compliant with regulatory requirements.

Platform-Native: Choosing Your Approach Data Governance Tools and the New AI Governance Requirement A Practical Framework for Choosing a Data Governance Tool Data governance tools enforce access control, data quality checks, and lineage tracking at the platform layer, blocking unauthorized or corrupted data before it reaches analytics, BI, and AI/ML workloads.

Evaluation criteria such as policy enforcement granularity and AI/agent governance vary widely across data governance tools, and as autonomous agents query production data directly, tool-level governance coverage becomes critical to preventing unsanctioned data access.

summaryLines: 데이터 거버넌스 도구는 조직이 데이터 자산을 분류, 보호, 모니터링 및 감사하여 데이터가 정확하고 검색 가능하며 규제 요구 사항을 준수하도록 돕는 소프트웨어 플랫폼임
플랫폼 기반 · 접근 방식 선택 데이터 거버넌스 도구 및 새로운 AI 거버넌스 요구 사항 데이터 거버넌스 도구 선택을 위한 실용적인 프레임워크 데이터 거버넌스 도구는 플랫폼 계층에서 액세스 제어, 데이터 품질 확인 및 계보 추적을 시행하여 승인되지 않거나 손상된 데이터가 분석, BI 및 AI/ML 워크로드에 도달하기 전에 차단함
정책 시행 세분성 및 AI/에이전트 거버넌스와 같은 평가 기준은 데이터 거버넌스 도구에 따라 크게 다르며 자율 에이전트가 프로덕션 데이터를 직접 쿼리하므로 도구 수준 거버넌스 적용 범위는 승인되지 않은 데이터 액세스를 방지하는 데 중요함

articles.titleEn: Anthropic Economic Index: Insights from Claude 3.7 Sonnet
summaryLinesEn: Today, we’re releasing our second research report from the Index, covering usage data on Claude.ai following the launch of Claude 3.7 Sonnet —our newest and most capable model with strengths in agentic coding and a new “extended thinking” mode.

Last month, we launched the Anthropic Economic Index —a new initiative where we’re regularly releasing data and research aimed at understanding AI's effects on labor markets and the economy over time.

While this increase in coding usage was expected due to Claude 3.7 Sonnet’s improved scores on coding benchmarks, the increase in these other categories could reflect either ongoing diffusion of AI throughout the economy, novel applications of coding to those domains, or unexpected capability improvements in the model.

localization.title: 인류경제지수 · Claude 3.7 Sonnet의 통찰
summaryLines: 오늘 우리는 에이전트 코딩과 새로운 "확장 사고" 모드의 강점을 갖춘 최신이자 가장 유능한 모델인 Claude 3.7 Sonnet 출시 이후 Claude.ai의 사용 데이터를 다루는 Index의 두 번째 연구 보고서를 발표함
지난 달 우리는 시간이 지남에 따라 AI가 노동 시장과 경제에 미치는 영향을 이해하기 위한 데이터와 연구를 정기적으로 공개하는 새로운 이니셔티브인 인류 경제 지수(Anthropic Economic Index)를 시작함
코딩 사용량의 이러한 증가는 Claude 3.7 Sonnet의 코딩 벤치마크 점수 향상으로 인해 예상되었지만, 이러한 다른 범주의 증가는 경제 전반에 걸친 AI의 지속적인 확산, 해당 영역에 대한 새로운 코딩 적용 또는 모델의 예상치 못한 기능 향상을 반영할 수 있음

articles.titleEn: Launching the Anthropic Economic Futures Programme in the UK and Europe
summaryLinesEn: The Anthropic Economic Index , which examines the use of Claude in the real world, reveals that AI adoption is already widespread in industries throughout the UK and Europe.

articles.title: Introducing the Anthropic Economic Index
articles.descEn: Announcement of the new Anthropic Economic Index and description of the new data on AI use in occupations
articles.titleEn: Introducing the Anthropic Economic Index
summaryLinesEn: The main findings from the Economic Index’s first paper are: Today, usage is concentrated in software development and technical writing tasks.

We’d therefore expect AI to be adopted selectively for different tasks across different occupations, and that analyzing tasks—in addition to jobs as a whole—would give us a fuller picture of how AI is being integrated into the economy.
We don’t survey people on their AI use, or attempt to forecast the future; instead, we have direct data on how AI is actually being used.

articles.title: What 81,000 people told us about the economics of AI
articles.descEn: Anthropic's recent survey of 81,000 Claude users provides a way to connect people’s economic concerns with what we’ve quantified in Claude traffic.
articles.titleEn: What 81,000 people told us about the economics of AI
summaryLinesEn: In order to inform the public about the economic changes we’re observing with AI, our Economic Index shares what work Claude is being asked to do, and in which jobs Claude is doing the largest share of tasks.
Our recent survey of 81,000 Claude users shows that people who work in roles that are more exposed to AI have more concerns about AI-driven job displacement.
In contrast, some users sped up tasks they were already doing, like the accountant who said, “I built a tool that helps me finish a financing task in 15 minutes that used to take 2 hours.”

localization.title: 81,000명의 사람들이 AI의 경제학에 관해 우리에게 말한 것
summaryLines: 우리가 AI를 통해 관찰하고 있는 경제적 변화를 대중에게 알리기 위해 우리의 경제 지수는 Claude가 수행하도록 요청받은 작업과 Claude가 가장 많은 작업을 수행하는 작업을 공유함
81,000명의 Claude 사용자를 대상으로 한 최근 설문조사에 따르면 AI에 더 많이 노출되는 역할에 종사하는 사람들은 AI로 인한 일자리 대체에 대해 더 많은 우려를 갖고 있는 것으로 나타남
반면 일부 사용자는 "2시간이 걸리던 자금 조달 작업을 15분 만에 완료할 수 있는 도구를 만들었습니다"라고 말한 회계사와 같이 이미 하고 있던 작업의 속도를 높였음

articles.title: Anthropic Economic Index report: Economic primitives
articles.descEn: This report introduces new metrics of AI usage to provide a rich portrait of interactions with Claude in November 2025, just prior to the release of Opus 4.5.
articles.titleEn: Anthropic Economic Index report: Economic primitives
summaryLinesEn: In our last Anthropic Economic Index Report we began tracking business adoption patterns by studying Claude usage among 1P API customers.

Data from November 2025 points to a broad-based shift back toward augmented use on Claude.ai: The share of conversations classified as augmented jumped 5pp to 52% and the share deemed automated fell 4pp to 45%.

Perhaps the most notable development for API customers was the increase in the share of transcripts associated with Office and Administrative Support related tasks, which rose 3pp in August to 13% in November 2025.

articles.title: The patch window is collapsing: Why security needs a new control plane | Microsoft Azure Blog
articles.descEn: Learn why Microsoft is investing in new and innovative capabilities able to give organizations time to safely validate and deploy patches.
articles.titleEn: The patch window is collapsing: Why security needs a new control plane | Microsoft Azure Blog
summaryLinesEn: Mission-critical applications power revenue-generating services, customer experiences, and core business operations that cannot simply be taken offline whenever a security update becomes available.

The patch window is collapsing: Why security needs a new control plane For decades, cybersecurity defenders have relied on a relatively straightforward model: a vulnerability is disclosed, security teams assess exposure, test available fixes, deploy patches into production, and ultimately close the risk before attackers can exploit it at scale.
Security researchers and attackers alike needed to analyze documentation, understand exploit conditions, study affected software, and develop attack techniques.

articles.title: Granite 4.2 LLMs: How They're Built
articles.descEn: A Blog post by IBM Granite on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: Granite 4.2 LLMs: How They're Built
summaryLinesEn: Granite 4.2 models are built on a decoder-only dense transformer architecture with the following core components: Attention: Grouped Query Attention (GQA) with 40 attention heads and 8 KV heads Position Embedding: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) with θ = 10,000,000 Embeddings: Separate input/output embeddings (not tied) Granite 4.2 is trained from scratch on approximately 15 trillion tokens using a five-phase training strategy.
Each phase uses a distinct data mixture and learning-rate schedule, gradually shifting from broad web-scale data toward more curated, high-quality sources.
Every model can produce a chain of thought before its answer and can run in thinking or non-thinking mode depending on how much deliberation a task needs.

localization.title: Granite 4.2 LLM: 구축 방법
summaryLines: Granite 4.2 모델은 다음 핵심 구성 요소를 갖춘 디코더 전용 고밀도 변환기 아키텍처를 기반으로 구축됨 · 주의 · 주의 헤드 40개와 KV 헤드 8개를 갖춘 GQA(Grouped Query Attention) 위치 임베딩 · θ = 10,000,000인 RoPE(Rotary Position Embedding) 임베딩 · 별도의 입력/출력 임베딩(묶이지 않음) Granite 4.2는 5단계 훈련 전략
각 단계는 고유한 데이터 혼합 및 학습 속도 일정을 사용하여 광범위한 웹 규모 데이터에서 보다 선별된 고품질 소스로 점진적으로 이동함
모든 모델은 답을 얻기 전에 일련의 사고를 생성할 수 있으며 작업에 필요한 숙고 정도에 따라 사고 모드 또는 비사고 모드로 실행될 수 있음

articles.descEn: Databricks brings declarative ETL to the SQL Editor with APPEND, AUTO CDC, and REPLACE WHERE flows in Lakehouswe.
articles.titleEn: Modernizing SQL ETL in Lakehouse with Declarative Patterns | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Practitioners can easily execute query-level ETL tasks inside their standard SQL workflows, or transition to the Lakeflow Pipelines Editor for multi-step, project-oriented development.

Databricks is bringing declarative ETL to data warehousing workflows in Lakehouse , making it easier for SQL practitioners to simplify complex transformation logic in familiar places they already work.
Instead of needing to work in a dedicated pipelines-oriented environment, SQL users can now define common ETL patterns directly within their SQL queries in Databricks Lakehouse.

articles.titleEn: Americans want transparency when AI is used in their healthcare
summaryLinesEn: A small share (16%) say their doctors or other healthcare providers have ever used AI in their healthcare.
Scheduling is the task that the largest share feels they do not need to be told about (33%).
Among those who say their providers have used AI in their care, the largest share say they understand somewhat well how it’s been used (44%).

summaryLinesEn: Apple Intelligence is available with support for these languages: English, Danish, Dutch, French, German, Italian, Norwegian, Portuguese, Spanish, Swedish, Turkish, Vietnamese, Chinese (simplified), Chinese (traditional), Japanese, and Korean.

articles.title: Quantization-Aware Healing: a compressed, 4-bit model that outperforms its full-precision original
articles.descEn: A Blog post by Multiverse Computing on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: Quantization-Aware Healing: a compressed, 4-bit model that outperforms its full-precision original
summaryLinesEn: The idea that a 4-bit model can actually outperform the full-precision version turns the usual assumption about quantization completely upside down....

Our latest paper, Quantization-Aware Healing: A Practical Recipe for Recovering Compressed, 4-Bit LLMs , asks a question that the field has mostly left open: once a model has already been through structural compression, not just quantization, how well does that recovery step actually work, and what is the right way to do it?
Turning a heavily compressed 4-bit model into something that can outperform its larger full-precision counterpart is the kind of result that makes you rethink what "compression" actually means.

localization.title: 양자화 인식 치유 · 전체 정밀도 원본보다 성능이 뛰어난 압축된 4비트 모델
summaryLines: 4비트 모델이 실제로 완전 정밀도 버전보다 성능이 뛰어날 수 있다는 생각은 양자화에 대한 일반적인 가정을 완전히 뒤집어 놓음
최신 논문인 Quantization-Aware Healing: A Practical Recipe for Recovering Compressed, 4-Bit LLMs에서는 해당 분야가 대부분 열려 있는 질문을 던짐 · 모델이 이미 양자화뿐만 아니라 구조적 압축을 거친 후에는 해당 복구 단계가 실제로 얼마나 잘 작동하며 이를 수행하는 올바른 방법은 무엇입니까
심하게 압축된 4비트 모델을 더 큰 전체 정밀도 모델보다 뛰어난 성능을 발휘할 수 있는 것으로 바꾸는 것은 "압축"이 실제로 무엇을 의미하는지 다시 생각하게 만드는 결과임

articles.title: Wire It, Run It, Deploy It: AI Workflows in Gradio
articles.descEn: We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
articles.titleEn: Wire It, Run It, Deploy It: AI Workflows in Gradio
summaryLinesEn: We don't always need to rely on Inference Providers or existing Gradio Spaces.

We usually wire these steps together in Python, and the moment something looks off we go back to print-debugging to find which step produced the odd value. gr.Workflow , built right into Gradio, makes the pipeline the interface .
But an fn node is just Python, which means it can also run a model inside the Space on a GPU.

articles.title: Gemini Robotics 2 brings whole body intelligence to robots
articles.descEn: From feet to fingertips — we are teaching robots intelligent whole-body control, fine dexterity, and teamwork to complete a broad range of complex tasks.
articles.titleEn: Gemini Robotics 2 brings whole body intelligence to robots
summaryLinesEn: It can even team up with other robots to finish the job faster.
Gemini Robotics 2 enables robots to reason through every movement, unlocking a broad range of tasks.

Gemini Robotics 2 controlling three different embodiments, using the same model checkpoint — the Apptronik Apollo 2 robot with SharpaWave hands, the Apollo 2 robot with Inspire hands, and the Franka Duo with the Robotiq gripper — on a wide variety of whole-body and dexterous manipulation tasks.

articles.title: BlackBerry CEO says robotics is one of its fastest-growing businesses
articles.descEn: BlackBerry CEO John Giamatteo says robotics is one of QNX’s fastest-growing businesses as the company expands its software beyond cars.
articles.titleEn: BlackBerry CEO says robotics is one of its fastest-growing businesses
summaryLinesEn: QNX is embedded in 275 million vehicles and has a roughly $950 million royalty backlog, part of which comes from robotics, the company said.
In April, BlackBerry announced an expanded partnership with Nvidia to deploy its software alongside Nvidia's systems in robotics, medical technologies and industrial applications.
Robotics is one of the company's "fastest-growing businesses inside the QNX portfolio," the CEO said.

articles.title: Free accounts can now access ChatGPT's upgraded task scheduling tool - Engadget
articles.descEn: Meanwhile, paid accounts can configure prompts to trigger when things happen in Gmail, Slack or GitHub.
articles.titleEn: Free accounts can now access ChatGPT's upgraded task scheduling tool - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: For instance, you can set up travel alerts related to an upcoming trip, or tell ChatGPT to notify you of new movies and TV shows as they're added to your favorite streaming services.
The company also introduced enhancements to ChatGPT's ability to complete tasks in the future, making it easier to track and edit those requests.
At the same time, OpenAI has made it possible to share scheduled tasks with other users, so that if you think of a clever use of the feature, others can benefit from it for their own workflows.

articles.title: Russia used ChatGPT to run a covert influence campaign pushing pro-Kremlin narratives across the West
articles.descEn: OpenAI has disrupted a covert Russian influence campaign that used ChatGPT to generate social media posts by banning a cluster of accounts. The operators accessed the platform through VPNs from Russia and promoted the fictitious "International Burke Institute," including German-language Telegram content critical of the EU and the German government. The campaign's reach stayed small, but OpenAI warns the infrastructure behind it could have been scaled up over time.

summaryLinesEn: The linked Telegram channels, however, each reached 10,000 to 20,000 followers.

articles.title: Google launches Gemini for legal work to automate contracts and research
articles.descEn: With Gemini Enterprise for Legal, Google launches an AI solution for the legal industry that connects to systems like iManage, DocuSign, and Everlaw through MCP connectors. Partners like Deloitte sell ready-made AI agents for tasks like contract review. Anthropic already offers similar solutions. All providers use the same models as in their other products.
articles.titleEn: Google launches Gemini for legal work to automate contracts and research
summaryLinesEn: A similar offering launched today for financial services , with healthcare and life sciences versions on the way.
These industry-specific packages from all providers boil down to pre-built prompts, called "skills" because they can be executed and edited by agents, and connections to relevant data sources.
The system reviews contracts, runs legal research, and tracks regulatory changes while respecting existing access permissions.

articles.title: Your brain on AI
articles.descEn: Much as GPS weakens our navigation skills, relying on chatbots can undermine our ability to detect fake news.
articles.titleEn: Your brain on AI
summaryLinesEn: Many people find AI-based chatbots helpful in keeping up with news, but a study by Pattie Maes and her colleagues at the MIT Media Lab points to a big problem with this strategy.

Popular A fundamental flaw leaves LLMs strikingly vulnerable to attack Will Douglas Heaven Anthropic found a hidden space where Claude puzzles over concepts Will Douglas Heaven Sperm donors need limits, says a European fertility group Jessica Hamzelou AI is more likely than humans to form biases when hiring Michelle Kim It makes it easy to trick them into doing things they shouldn’t, such as telling you how to sabotage an aircraft’s navigation system.
The researchers also found, however, that certain AI styles were associated with stronger independent performance later on, even if they slowed people down at first.

The researchers also found, however, that certain AI styles were associated with stronger independent performance later on, even if they slowed people down at first.

summaryLines: 많은 사람들이 뉴스를 따라가는 데 AI 기반 챗봇이 도움이 된다고 생각하지만, MIT 미디어 랩의 Pattie Maes와 동료들의 연구는 이 전략에 큰 문제가 있음을 지적함

인기 있는 근본적인 결함으로 인해 LLM은 공격에 매우 취약해짐 · Will Douglas Heaven Anthropic은 Claude가 개념을 놓고 고민하는 숨겨진 공간을 발견함 · Will Douglas Heaven 정자 기증자에게는 제한이 필요하다고 유럽의 출산 그룹 Jessica Hamzelou AI는 인간보다 Michelle Kim을 고용할 때 편견을 형성할 가능성이 더 높다고 말함 · 항공기 항법 시스템을 방해하는 방법을 알려주는 등 해서는 안 되는 일을 하도록 그들을 속이기 쉽음
그러나 연구원들은 특정 AI 스타일이 처음에는 사람들의 속도를 늦추더라도 나중에 더 강력한 독립적인 성능과 관련이 있다는 사실도 발견함

articles.title: Ropedia launches next-gen wearable capture device for robotic AI training data - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: Ropedia launches next-gen wearable capture device for robotic AI training data - SiliconANGLE
articles.titleEn: Ropedia launches next-gen wearable capture device for robotic AI training data - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: Most of the training data used to build the artificial intelligence foundation models that drive robots comes from videos of humans doing tasks such as picking up objects, moving them and completing other simple or procedural tasks.

“Hardware-synchronizing four camera streams, spatial audio and inertial data to within 50 microseconds means our models can treat a session as one continuous signal instead of reconciling four separate ones,” said Chief Scientist Ziwei Liu, who’s an associate professor at Nanyang Technological University in Singapore.
The company said HOMIE Gen2 is designed to be the first egocentric capture device with a 360-degree field of view for robot training.

articles.title: Claude Cowork finally remembers what you told the app in chat
articles.descEn: Anthropic is giving Claude a shared memory across chat and Cowork, so users no longer have to repeatedly brief the AI on projects, preferences, and other context.
articles.titleEn: Claude Cowork finally remembers what you told the app in chat
summaryLinesEn: Before, you may have developed ideas for projects over time while chatting with Claude, but when it came time to actually enact the changes, you’d have to start over by telling Cowork all the details.

On Tuesday, Anthropic announced it’s merging the memory system used by chat and Claude Cowork, which means that Claude will always remember what it learned in one area, even when you’re engaging with it in another.
In less than 48 hours, your chance to save up to $300 on your tickets will end!

summaryLines: 이전에는 Claude와 대화하면서 시간이 지남에 따라 프로젝트에 대한 아이디어를 개발했을 수도 있지만 실제로 변경 사항을 실행해야 할 때가 되면 Cowork에 모든 세부 사항을 알리고 다시 시작해야 함

48시간 이내에 티켓을 최대 $300까지 절약할 수 있는 기회가 종료됨

articles.titleEn: AI storage infrastructure supports scalable AI inference - SiliconANGLE AI inference gets a new tier as context windows grow - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: Those results depend on an AI storage infrastructure that can match storage performance and capacity to the workload.
AI storage infrastructure must therefore provide additional tiers that balance proximity, capacity and speed, with each layer handling a different part of the data load, according to Shadley.
AI storage infrastructure brings KV cache closer to compute As context windows expand, graphics processing unit memory alone can’t hold everything an agentic workload needs during inference.

summaryLinesEn: This is a central feature of the AI factory, and Cisco, in partnership with Nvidia, is positioning its portfolio to supply the operational foundation that can drive this model.

Designed to give customers a framework for deploying artificial intelligence across their entire infrastructure, Secure AI Factory with Nvidia from Cisco Systems Inc. now integrates rack-to-fabric liquid cooling supporting systems beyond 200 kilowatts per rack for reasoning, agentic AI and trillion-parameter training.
