articles.title: Apple's M5 Ultra with an 80-core GPU will power through your AI models and 8K video - Engadget
articles.descEn: With the launch of the latest Mac mini and Mac Studio computers, Apple introduced new chips with cutting-edge technology.
articles.titleEn: Apple's M5 Ultra with an 80-core GPU will power through your AI models and 8K video - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: Boosting those speeds further is a next-gen 80-core (max) GPU with a neural accelerator in each core that bumps peak AI compute 4.5 times compared to the M3 Ultra, while boosting graphics performance by 40 percent.

With all that, the M6 "delivers the world's fastest single-threaded performance and up to 1.2x faster multi-threaded performance as compared to M5," according to Apple.The company is also promising a 30 percent uplift in neural processing, along with improvements to the shader core architecture, dynamic caching and hardware-accelerated ray tracing.
The M5 Ultra supports up to 512GB of high-bandwidth unified memory with 1.2TB/s of bandwidth, up 50 percent over the M3 Ultra.

articles.title: Ukraine opens its massive labeled battlefield dataset to British firms in a landmark AI weapons partnership
articles.descEn: The UK becomes the first country to get access to Avengers Labs, Ukraine's platform holding roughly five million annotated combat images for training military AI. Three British startups are already working on pilot projects. The deal shows how real war data is systematically becoming the currency for building out autonomous weapons tech.
articles.titleEn: Ukraine opens its massive labeled battlefield dataset to British firms in a landmark AI weapons partnership
summaryLinesEn: The deal is part of the two countries' so-called "100 Year Partnership."

These ranged from the autonomous attack drone Saker Scout introduced that year , meant to identify military objects on its own and strike them in autonomous mode, to Auterion's Skynode S technology and the drone swarms now used regularly.
According to the ministry, it identifies 70 percent of enemy equipment shown in video streams and needs just 2.2 seconds per object.

articles.title: Meta's paid AI agent Hatch launches soon, with a new model called Watermelon due in October
articles.descEn: Meta Platforms will launch its AI agent Hatch in the coming weeks and release a new AI model called Watermelon in October.
articles.titleEn: Meta's paid AI agent Hatch launches soon, with a new model called Watermelon due in October
summaryLinesEn: Meta Platforms will launch its AI agent Hatch in the coming weeks and release a new AI model called Watermelon in October.
Hatch is designed to tap into sites like DoorDash, Etsy, Reddit, Yelp, and Outlook, and to offer a customizable dashboard with features like a fitness tracker or trip planner.
Whether Watermelon becomes part of the Muse model family or ships as a standalone model is still unclear.

articles.descEn: No one really knows how to safely test frontier AI models.
articles.titleEn: The Download: smarter AI in schools, and a robot “carnival” in Shanghai
summaryLinesEn: The Download: Google’s AI shake-up and Meta’s rogue model Plus: Meta has become the latest firm to say its AI hacked another company.
Showcases like this event are important because they invite the public to experience robots up close.
Suddenly, students carried an app in their phones that could magically answer almost any homework question or spin up an essay in seconds.

articles.title: Accel-backed Keenable is indexing the web for AI agents
articles.descEn: Now exiting stealth mode with a $26 million seed round, Keenable has been building a vast web search index for AI agents.
articles.titleEn: Accel-backed Keenable is indexing the web for AI agents
summaryLinesEn: According to Accel partner Zhenya Loginov, who led the investment, AI players have very few options when it comes to web-scale search infrastructure, especially with Google and Microsoft taking steps to shut down their existing search APIs to avoid cannibalization.

Styskin says while it is “extremely hard” to convince people to move away from Google for search, the innovators’ dilemma means that the U.S. giant is potentially “beatable” on agentic queries, and a smaller company like Keenable can innovate and offer a more cost-efficient solution to AI companies.

Keenable says it has been building a web search index of more than 100 billion documents, and its API is already used in production at several AI labs and inference providers during both training and runtime.

localization.title: Accel 지원 Keenable은 AI 에이전트를 위해 웹을 인덱싱하고 있음
summaryLines: 투자를 주도한 Accel 파트너 Zhenya Loginov에 따르면 AI 플레이어는 웹 규모 검색 인프라와 관련하여 옵션이 거의 없으며 특히 Google과 Microsoft가 잠식을 피하기 위해 기존 검색 API를 종료하는 조치를 취하고 있음
Styskin은 사람들이 검색을 위해 Google을 떠나도록 설득하는 것이 "매우 어렵지만" 혁신가의 딜레마는 미국의 거대 기업이 에이전트 쿼리에서 잠재적으로 "패배"할 수 있으며 Keenable과 같은 소규모 회사가 AI 회사에 더 비용 효율적인 솔루션을 혁신하고 제공할 수 있음을 의미한다고 말함
Keenable은 1,000억 개 이상의 문서로 구성된 웹 검색 색인을 구축해 왔으며 해당 API는 이미 여러 AI 연구소 및 추론 제공업체에서 교육 및 런타임 중에 생산에 사용되고 있다고 밝힘

articles.title: How Claude's text watermarking works
articles.descEn: Future Claude models will generate text that contains a watermark. This is a way of determining the likelihood that Claude was involved in writing the text, and we, along with several other major AI providers, are implementing this change to comply with the EU AI Act. In this article, we share answers to some of the questions we’ve received about how our chosen watermarking method works, whether it affects Claude’s outputs, and why we’re making this change.
articles.titleEn: How Claude's text watermarking works
summaryLinesEn: In this article, we share answers to some of the questions we’ve received about how our chosen watermarking method works, whether it affects Claude’s outputs, and why we’re making this change.

In the SynthID-Text paper , which introduced the technique we use, Google DeepMind tested this impact by serving a model that used watermarking to a portion of their Gemini traffic and comparing thumbs-up and thumbs-down ratings.
In internal testing, we’ve seen no impact of watermarking on the content, level of creativity, or readability of Claude’s text.

localization.title: Claude의 텍스트 워터마킹 작동 방식
summaryLines: 이 글에서는 우리가 선택한 워터마킹 방법이 어떻게 작동하는지, 그것이 Claude의 출력에 영향을 미치는지, 그리고 이러한 변경을 하는 이유에 대해 받은 몇 가지 질문에 대한 답변을 공유함
우리가 사용하는 기술을 소개한 SynthID-Text 논문에서 Google DeepMind는 Gemini 트래픽의 일부에 워터마킹을 사용하는 모델을 제공하고 좋아요 및 싫어요 평가를 비교하여 이러한 영향을 테스트함
내부 테스트에서 워터마킹이 Claude 텍스트의 콘텐츠, 창의성 수준 또는 가독성에 미치는 영향을 확인하지 못함

articles.descEn: The massive growth of generative AI has fundamentally altered data center design. As distributed model training scales to span hundreds of thousands of GPUs…
articles.titleEn: Giga-Scale AI and the Ethernet Evolution: How Spectrum-X Ethernet Rewrites the Rules | NVIDIA Technical Blog
summaryLinesEn: This allows a simple two-tier topology to scale to over 128,000 endpoints, or up to 16 million endpoints with a three-tier topology, without introducing the latency and jitter bottlenecks of a traditional multi-tier fabric topology.
To bridge this gap, NVIDIA introduced Spectrum-X Ethernet , a hardware-accelerated networking architecture designed from the ground up for giga-scale AI factories.

Demystifying Multiplane topology and Spectrum-X Multiplane technology To scale an AI factory to hundreds of thousands of GPUs, traditional networking architectures require adding additional tiers (e.g., moving from a 2-tier to a 3-tier fat-tree topology).

summaryLines: 이를 통해 기존 다중 계층 패브릭 토폴로지의 대기 시간 및 지터 병목 현상을 발생시키지 않고도 간단한 2계층 토폴로지를 128,000개 이상의 엔드포인트로 확장하거나 3계층 토폴로지를 사용하여 최대 1,600만 개의 엔드포인트로 확장할 수 있음

articles.title: Nvidia senior manager tied to ex-Supermicro staff's AI smuggling scheme
articles.descEn: Nvidia worker indicted after Jensen Huang scolded Supermicro for AI server smuggling.
articles.titleEn: Nvidia senior manager tied to ex-Supermicro staff's AI smuggling scheme
summaryLinesEn: Taiwan has indicted nine people— reportedly including an Nvidia senior manager and two Supermicro employees based in the country—who allegedly helped forge documents to cover up illegal exports of high-end AI servers to China in violation of US export controls.

But after the US arrested Supermicro co-founder Wally Liaw in March for allegedly funneling $2.5 billion in restricted AI servers to China since 2024, Taiwan launched a separate probe to learn more about the scheme.

In May, before any Nvidia employees were linked directly to the scheme, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was highly critical of Supermicro for its failing compliance program, urging that a fix was needed, Tom’s Hardware reported .

In May, before any Nvidia employees were linked directly to the scheme, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was highly critical of Supermicro for its failing compliance program, urging that a fix was needed, Tom’s Hardware reported .

localization.title: Nvidia 수석 관리자가 전 Supermicro 직원의 AI 밀수 계획에 연관되어 있음
summaryLines: 대만은 미국 수출 통제를 위반하여 중국에 대한 고급 AI 서버 불법 수출을 은폐하기 위해 문서를 위조하는 데 도움을 준 것으로 알려진 Nvidia 고위 관리자와 대만에 있는 Supermicro 직원 2명을 포함해 9명을 기소함
그러나 미국이 지난 3월 2024년부터 제한된 AI 서버에 25억 달러를 중국에 제공한 혐의로 Supermicro 공동 창업자인 Wally Liaw를 체포한 후, 대만은 이 계획에 대해 자세히 알아보기 위해 별도의 조사에 착수함
Nvidia 직원이 이 계획에 직접 연결되기 전인 5월, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang은 Supermicro의 실패한 규정 준수 프로그램에 대해 매우 비판적이며 수정이 필요하다고 촉구했다고 Tom's Hardware가 보도함

그러나 미국이 지난 3월 2024년부터 제한된 AI 서버에 25억 달러를 중국에 제공한 혐의로 Supermicro 공동 창업자인 Wally Liaw를 체포한 후, 대만은 이 계획에 대해 자세히 알아보기 위해 별도의 조사에 착수함
Nvidia 직원이 이 계획에 직접 연결되기 전인 5월, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang은 Supermicro의 실패한 규정 준수 프로그램에 대해 매우 비판적이며 수정이 필요하다고 촉구했다고 Tom's Hardware가 보도함

articles.title: Xiaomi Develops Its Own AI Mobile Chip in Challenge to Qualcomm
articles.descEn: Xiaomi Corp. launched a mobile processor for its marquee devices, putting pressure on Qualcomm Inc. and MediaTek Inc., which for years supplied the key component to the Chinese company.

summaryLinesEn: Xiaomi Corp. launched a mobile processor for its marquee devices, putting pressure on Qualcomm Inc. and MediaTek Inc. , which for years supplied the key component to the Chinese company.

articles.title: AWS WorkSpacesがAIエージェントによるレガシー・デスクトップアプリケーション操作を可能に、API不要
articles.descEn: AWSはAmazon WorkSpacesがAIエージェント向けのマネージド仮想デスクトップとして利用可能になったと発表した。これによりアプリケーションのモダナイゼーションやAPI統合を必要とせず、Computer Visionと入力シミュレーションを通じてレガシー・デスクトップアプリケーションを操作可能になる。
articles.titleEn: AWS WorkSpacesがAIエージェントによるレガシー・デスクトップアプリケーション操作を可能に、API不要
summaryLinesEn: 2024年Gartnerレポート によると75%の組織がモダンAPIを持たないレガシーアプリケーションを運用しており、Fortune 500企業の71%が適切なプログラムアクセス手段を持たないメインフレームシステム上でクリティカルな業務プロセスを実行している。
AIコーディング企業 Reflexは最近、 ベンチマーク調査結果を公開し 、ビジョンエージェントがあるタスクを完了するために約50万入力トークンを消費したのに対し、APIエージェントは1万2,000トークンで処理したと報告、45倍のコスト差があることを示した。
これによりアプリケーションのモダナイゼーションやAPI統合を必要とせず、Computer Visionと入力シミュレーションを通じてレガシー・デスクトップアプリケーションを操作可能になる。

articles.title: Intelligence at pocket scale: Benchmarking small models and mobile phones
articles.descEn: Independent intelligence benchmarking of small language models on a set of evaluations chosen for mobile device use, launched alongside mobile phone inference benchmarking with Liquid AI. We evaluate the same quantized builds used on mobile phones, and performance is measured on real devices.
articles.titleEn: Intelligence at pocket scale: Benchmarking small models and mobile phones
summaryLinesEn: End-to-End Generation Time | iPhone 17 Pro A simple average of five evaluations chosen to represent real-world mobile device usage, run against models small enough to fit on portable hardware and each measured independently by Artificial Analysis.

But a 64K window does not fit in mobile phone memory, and at 55 output tokens per second on an iPhone 17 Pro, generating 64K output tokens could mean a wait of more than twenty minutes and substantial battery use.
Nanbeige4.2-3B and LFM2.5-2.6B share the top average evaluation scores (with a 16K context limit) at launch, both scoring 63, ahead of Ornith-1.0-9B on 62 and Qwen3.5 9B (Reasoning) on 61.

articles.title: Introducing new Ray capabilities on SageMaker HyperPod | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now offers managed Ray support on Amazon EKS. Create and monitor Ray clusters, connect JupyterLab and Code Editor notebooks to live clusters, get out-of-the-box observability, and run resilient distributed training and accelerated inference from SageMaker Studio, all with open-source KubeRay and standard Ray APIs.
articles.titleEn: Introducing new Ray capabilities on SageMaker HyperPod | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Setting up Ray observability on Kubernetes with Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus and Amazon Managed Grafana is a multi-step process that involves installing Helm charts, creating PodMonitors and ServiceMonitors, configuring IAM roles for SigV4 signing, and manually importing dashboard JSON files.

SageMaker HyperPod provides purpose-built infrastructure for large-scale machine learning (ML) on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) with built-in node health monitoring and automatic recovery.

To follow along with this post, you need an Amazon SageMaker HyperPod cluster with Amazon EKS orchestration and the following components installed on your cluster: SageMaker Spaces EKS add-on , which enables JupyterLab and Code Editor workspaces in Amazon SageMaker HyperPod that attach to Ray clusters for interactive development.

summaryLines: Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus 및 Amazon Managed Grafana를 사용하여 Kubernetes에서 Ray 관찰 기능을 설정하는 것은 Helm 차트 설치, PodMonitor 및 ServiceMonitors 생성, SigV4 서명을 위한 IAM 역할 구성, 대시보드 JSON 파일 수동 가져오기가 포함된 다단계 프로세스임
SageMaker HyperPod는 내장된 노드 상태 모니터링 및 자동 복구 기능을 통해 Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service(Amazon EKS)에서 대규모 기계 학습(ML)을 위해 특별히 구축된 인프라를 제공함

이 게시물을 진행하려면 Amazon EKS 오케스트레이션이 포함된 Amazon SageMaker HyperPod 클러스터와 클러스터에 다음 구성 요소가 설치되어 있어야 함 · SageMaker Spaces EKS 추가 기능은 대화형 개발을 위해 Ray 클러스터에 연결되는 Amazon SageMaker HyperPod의 JupyterLab 및 코드 편집기 작업 공간을 활성화함

articles.title: Arm and UNICEF launch AI in Play to expand access to AI innovation
articles.descEn: Arm and UNICEF launch AI in Play to expand access to responsible AI, support local innovators and equip young people with AI skills.
articles.titleEn: Arm and UNICEF launch AI in Play to expand access to AI innovation
summaryLinesEn: “The decisions the tech industry makes about AI in the next four years will shape how a whole generation of children grow up, learn, and work,” said Kitty van der Heijden, UNICEF Deputy Executive Director of Partnerships.
Yet as AI adoption accelerates, access to the tools, data, and expertise needed to build AI systems remains uneven.

“Arm has shown what it looks like to make that decision with children in mind: a decade of joint work and an investment of expertise and resources to design AI in Play, an ecosystem open to the tech sector to join and play a critical and positive role in.”

localization.title: Arm과 UNICEF, AI 혁신에 대한 접근성 확대를 위해 AI in Play 출시
summaryLines: 유니세프 파트너십 담당 부국장인 키티 반 데르 헤이덴(Kitty van der Heijden)은 “향후 4년 동안 기술 산업이 AI에 대해 내리는 결정은 전 세대의 어린이가 어떻게 성장하고, 배우고, 일하는가를 결정하게 될 것임” · 라고 말함
그러나 AI 채택이 가속화됨에 따라 AI 시스템을 구축하는 데 필요한 도구, 데이터 및 전문 지식에 대한 액세스는 여전히 고르지 않음
"Arm은 아이들을 염두에 두고 그러한 결정을 내리는 것이 어떤 모습인지 보여주었음 · 즉, 기술 부문에 참여하여 중요하고 긍정적인 역할을 수행할 수 있는 개방형 생태계인 Play에서 AI를 설계하기 위한 10년 간의 공동 작업과 전문 지식 및 리소스 투자임"

articles.descEn: AWS Agent Registry gives your organization a centralized, searchable catalog for agents, tools, and skills. It works with the open Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) standard to enable cross-environment discovery and governance at scale.
articles.titleEn: Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD): An open specification for agent discovery | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: We expect ARD to open cross-organizational discovery paths for Agent Registry customers.

We expect ARD to enable cross-environment discovery while keeping control local.

articles.title: Building a restaurant telephony AI host with Amazon Connect | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Learn how to build a voice ordering system for restaurants that answers a phone call and takes an order end to end, with no app, no website, and no sign-in. It uses Amazon Connect for telephony, Amazon Connect Agentic Voice for real-time speech, an Amazon Connect AI agent for reasoning, and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway to reach backend tools through MCP.
articles.titleEn: Building a restaurant telephony AI host with Amazon Connect | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: At many restaurants, a large share of orders still arrive by phone, and those calls usually land on a staff member who is already taking care of customers at the counter.
Adding an app or a website helps customers who prefer to order online, but it does nothing for the person who wants to call and order.

The system uses Amazon Connect Customer for the telephony channel, Amazon Lex V2 with Amazon Connect Agentic Voice for real-time speech, and Amazon Connect Customer AI agents to orchestrate the conversation, connected to a restaurant backend through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore .

summaryLines: 많은 레스토랑에서는 여전히 전화로 주문이 많이 들어오고, 이러한 전화는 일반적으로 이미 카운터에서 고객을 관리하고 있는 직원에게 전달됨

articles.titleEn: Celebrate 110 years of national parks with Maps, Search, and Gemini
summaryLinesEn: National Parks Week celebrates 110 years of the National Park Service, and interest in outdoor travel is at an all-time high.
What people are searching in the lead-up to National Parks Week — plus, how Ask Maps, AI Mode, and the Gemini app can help turn your wanderlust into a well-planned adventure.
Search interest in “ how to plan a road trip ” increased by 190% over the past month, with Great Sand Dunes National Park as the top trending road trip destination.

summaryLines: 심사위원들은 특히 책임에 대한 감사 가능한 추론 추적과 Raspberry Pi 5 장치의 WebGPU 버퍼 오버플로를 방지하기 위해 Gemma 4 E2B를 사용하기로 한 결정을 강조하면서 프로젝트의 기술적 깊이를 높이 평가함

articles.title: AI-powered metadata correction and harmonization | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Metadata harmonization (standardizing labels, identifiers, and formats so datasets can work together) is still largely manual. This post shows how AI-powered metadata correction works in practice, covering two approaches, human-in-the-loop validation and autonomous agent-driven workflows, plus governance considerations for production deployment.
articles.titleEn: AI-powered metadata correction and harmonization | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: The system then performs two parallel validation streams: schema alignment verifies that column structures match expected formats, while metadata field validation examines individual field values for compliance.
By prioritizing classical NLP and embedding-based similarity before invoking LLMs, the workflow achieves accurate, scalable recommendations while keeping inference costs predictable.

AI-powered metadata correction and harmonization offers a way forward, transforming metadata management from a time-consuming responsibility into a process that scales with your data volume and supports open science rather than obstructing it.

articles.title: How XPUs Meet a World-Class AI Factory
articles.descEn: Deploying custom silicon with leading AI infrastructure enables hyperscalers and AI-native companies to build flexible AI factories that combine specialization with scale.
articles.titleEn: How XPUs Meet a World-Class AI Factory
summaryLinesEn: Hyperscalers and AI-native companies building custom XPUs must consider not just XPU design, but the design and development of the entire AI platform, including scale-up and scale-out networking, rack-scale architecture, production factory software and a robust supplier ecosystem.
NVLink Fusion delivers on that need, connecting XPUs to NVIDIA’s world-leading AI infrastructure to increase performance, accelerate time to market and mitigate risk for semi-custom AI factories.

NVLink Fusion also includes NVIDIA NVLink-C2C for connecting XPUs to NVIDIA Vera CPUs or other ecosystem CPUs, delivering up to 6x the energy efficiency of a PCIe interface — helping remove barriers between control and compute for agentic systems.

summaryLines: 맞춤형 XPU를 구축하는 하이퍼스케일러 및 AI 기반 기업은 XPU 설계뿐만 아니라 수직 확장 및 수평 확장 네트워킹, 랙 규모 아키텍처, 생산 공장 소프트웨어 및 강력한 공급업체 생태계를 포함한 전체 AI 플랫폼의 설계 및 개발도 고려해야 함
NVLink Fusion은 XPU를 NVIDIA의 세계 최고의 AI 인프라에 연결하여 성능을 높이고 출시 시간을 가속화하며 반 맞춤형 AI 공장의 위험을 완화함으로써 이러한 요구를 충족함
NVLink Fusion에는 XPU를 NVIDIA Vera CPU 또는 기타 생태계 CPU에 연결하기 위한 NVIDIA NVLink-C2C도 포함되어 있어 PCIe 인터페이스의 에너지 효율성을 최대 6배까지 높여 에이전트 시스템의 제어와 컴퓨팅 사이의 장벽을 제거하는 데 도움이 됨

NVLink Fusion은 XPU를 NVIDIA의 세계 최고의 AI 인프라에 연결하여 성능을 높이고 출시 시간을 가속화하며 반 맞춤형 AI 공장의 위험을 완화함으로써 이러한 요구를 충족함
NVLink Fusion에는 XPU를 NVIDIA Vera CPU 또는 기타 생태계 CPU에 연결하기 위한 NVIDIA NVLink-C2C도 포함되어 있어 PCIe 인터페이스의 에너지 효율성을 최대 6배까지 높여 에이전트 시스템의 제어와 컴퓨팅 사이의 장벽을 제거하는 데 도움이 됨

articles.titleEn: With Groq 3 LPX in Full Production, NVIDIA Extends Vera Rubin Inference for Agents
summaryLinesEn: To keep agents operating at the pace users expect, NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX extends the Vera Rubin NVL72 platform with specialized acceleration for token generation.
The SpaceXAI partnership extends NVIDIA’s full-stack AI platform to SpaceXAI, bringing together Vera CPUs, NVIDIA accelerated computing, networking and software to advance AI at unprecedented scale.

NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX extends the Vera Rubin NVL72 platform with a purpose-built inference architecture designed to maximize responsiveness, throughput and efficiency, helping power the next generation of AI factories.

summaryLines: 사용자가 기대하는 속도로 에이전트를 계속 운영하기 위해 NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX는 토큰 생성을 위한 특수 가속 기능을 통해 Vera Rubin NVL72 플랫폼을 확장함

articles.title: Up to 30x More Work Per Watt: NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 Sets a New Efficiency Standard for AI Agents
articles.descEn: New on-silicon performance data measured by NVIDIA using real-world agentic coding trajectories shows Vera Rubin NVL72 systems deliver 30x higher throughput per megawatt and 35x lower token costs than NVIDIA GB300 NVL72.
articles.titleEn: Up to 30x More Work Per Watt: NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 Sets a New Efficiency Standard for AI Agents
summaryLinesEn: New measured performance data shows NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems deliver up to 30x higher throughput per megawatt than NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 on agentic workloads.
These early results for Vera Rubin NVL72 demonstrate NVIDIA’s accelerated pace of innovation.
At up to 35x lower cost per million tokens than GB300 NVL72, Vera Rubin NVL72 can run agents continuously, at scale, across the full breadth of customers’ workloads.

articles.title: IBM and Arm: Expanding the Arm ecosystem for the next era of enterprise computing
articles.descEn: IBM is bringing Arm natively to future IBM Z and LinuxONE systems, expanding the Arm software ecosystem into mission-critical enterprise computing.
articles.titleEn: IBM and Arm: Expanding the Arm ecosystem for the next era of enterprise computing
summaryLinesEn: That momentum – reinforced by a software ecosystem of more than 22 million developers worldwide – is now extending into mission-critical enterprise computing.

IBM’s decision to bring Arm compute and its software ecosystem to Z and LinuxONE reflects a broader shift: software built and optimized for Arm across modern cloud and AI infrastructure is extending into the next generation of mission-critical enterprise computing.

It will allow Arm-native Linux environments to run alongside z/OS and existing Linux applications, bringing Arm software directly into these enterprise systems while giving Arm workloads the benefit of IBM’s enterprise-grade security and resilience.

localization.title: IBM과 Arm: 차세대 엔터프라이즈 컴퓨팅 시대를 위한 Arm 생태계 확장
summaryLines: 전 세계적으로 2,200만 명 이상의 개발자로 구성된 소프트웨어 생태계로 강화된 이러한 추진력은 이제 미션 크리티컬 엔터프라이즈 컴퓨팅으로 확장되고 있음
Arm 컴퓨팅과 해당 소프트웨어 에코시스템을 Z 및 LinuxONE에 도입하기로 한 IBM의 결정은 더 광범위한 변화를 반영함 · 최신 클라우드 및 AI 인프라 전반에 걸쳐 Arm용으로 구축 및 최적화된 소프트웨어는 차세대 미션 크리티컬 엔터프라이즈 컴퓨팅으로 확장되고 있음
이를 통해 Arm 네이티브 Linux 환경을 z/OS 및 기존 Linux 애플리케이션과 함께 실행할 수 있으며 Arm 소프트웨어를 이러한 엔터프라이즈 시스템에 직접 가져오는 동시에 Arm 워크로드에 IBM의 엔터프라이즈급 보안 및 탄력성의 이점을 제공할 수 있음

articles.title: Memory Shortage Drives Downturn in Flat Panel Display Market
articles.descEn: Global flat panel display (FPD) shipments are expected to decline 4.7% YoY in 2026 as dramatic price hikes for memory flow through to end market devices to suppress demand across key categories.
articles.titleEn: Memory Shortage Drives Downturn in Flat Panel Display Market
summaryLinesEn: Global flat panel display (FPD) shipments are expected to decline 4.7% YoY in 2026 as dramatic price hikes for memory flow through to end market devices to suppress demand across key categories.
TV shipments see minimal impact from the memory shortage, while automotive display demand remains solid, driven by secular trends.
The effect of the memory shortage on notebook and monitor panel shipments is less severe in 2026 than previously expected, but the downturn will extend into 2027.

The effect of the memory shortage on notebook and monitor panel shipments is less severe in 2026 than previously expected, but the downturn will extend into 2027.

localization.title: 메모리 부족으로 평면 디스플레이 시장 침체
summaryLines: 2026년 전 세계 평판 디스플레이(FPD) 출하량은 메모리 가격 인상이 최종 시장 장치까지 이어지며 주요 카테고리 전반의 수요를 억제함에 따라 전년 동기 대비 4.7% 감소할 것으로 예상됨
TV 출하량은 메모리 부족으로 인한 영향이 미미한 반면, 자동차 디스플레이 수요는 장기적인 추세에 따라 견조한 수준을 유지하고 있음
2026년에는 메모리 부족이 노트북과 모니터 패널 출하에 미치는 영향이 당초 예상보다 덜 심각하지만, 침체는 2027년까지 이어질 전망임

articles.title: Pew study confirms sharp rise of AI-written text on the web since ChatGPT's launch
articles.descEn: The Pew Research Center analyzed nearly half a million English-language web pages for AI-generated content. More than a third of pages published since ChatGPT's launch show signs of machine-written text, and commercial .com sites are ten times more likely to contain AI content than .edu or .gov domains.
articles.titleEn: Pew study confirms sharp rise of AI-written text on the web since ChatGPT's launch
summaryLinesEn: Ad A study by Imperial College London, the Internet Archive, and Stanford University from April 2026 reached a similar conclusion, finding that roughly 35 percent of all newly published websites were fully or partly AI-generated.
Since ChatGPT launched, the share of machine-written text online has climbed sharply.

The researchers also found 33 percent higher semantic similarity between AI texts and a much more positive tone overall but cautioned that public perception of negative effects often goes well beyond what the data actually supports.
articles.summary:
Ad A study by Imperial College London, the Internet Archive, and Stanford University from April 2026 reached a similar conclusion, finding that roughly 35 percent of all newly published websites were fully or partly AI-generated.
Since ChatGPT launched, the share of machine-written text online has climbed sharply.
The researchers also found 33 percent higher semantic similarity between AI texts and a much more positive tone overall but cautioned that public perception of negative effects often goes well beyond what the data actually supports.

sourceContent.headline: Pew study confirms sharp rise of AI-written text on the web since ChatGPT's launch

articles.title: Alibaba's Wan3.0 generates AI videos up to 30 seconds long from text, images, and documents
articles.descEn: Alibaba's video generation model Wan3.0 creates clips up to 30 seconds long from text, PDFs, and PowerPoint files. A 30-second 1080p clip costs $6. Alibaba's quarterly profit dropped 75 percent year-over-year as the company ramps up AI spending.
articles.titleEn: Alibaba's Wan3.0 generates AI videos up to 30 seconds long from text, images, and documents
summaryLinesEn: It produces videos up to 30 seconds long and accepts text, PDFs, web pages, and PowerPoint files as input.

The company just announced the largest share sale by a Hong Kong-listed company to fund its AI push, and last week reported a 75 percent year-over-year drop in quarterly profit driven by sharply higher AI investments.

Alibaba targets everything from film production to robotics training Alibaba is pitching Wan3.0 for a wide range of uses, from speeding up film production to generating short dramas and social media clips for content creators.

articles.title: Businesses must reinvent their processes and workforce to scale agentic AI adoption
articles.descEn: Only 15% of US-based organizations have reached scaled, orchestrated, multi-agent adoption, according to the latest Deloitte research.
articles.titleEn: Businesses must reinvent their processes and workforce to scale agentic AI adoption
summaryLinesEn: The future will be autonomous, but as of now, only 16% of business leaders said their current processes are prepared for agentic adoption.

Also: Business adoption of AI agents tripled this year - as measurable ROI emerges The question most business leaders struggle with is determining the viability of their business model and the impact of AI agents on existing processes and desired outcomes.
Only 31% of businesses expect to redesign and rebuild their processes around AI agents by 2028, yet 74% expect changes by 2030.

summaryLinesEn: The strongest claimed configuration is Acer's 14-inch OLED system at roughly $1,200, while Lenovo's detachable Duet M points to a 13-inch MediaTek-powered option.

articles.title: How to cancel your ChatGPT subscription (and why you might want to) - Engadget
articles.descEn: If you've had it with OpenAI, here's how to cancel your subscription and delete your account.
articles.titleEn: How to cancel your ChatGPT subscription (and why you might want to) - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: After OpenAI's February 2026 agreement with the US Department of Defense to deploy its models on the department's classified network, Sensor Tower data reported by TechCrunch showed US ChatGPT app uninstalls jumping 295 percent day over day .
Spending less doesn't necessarily require giving up a paid plan altogether.

If you have lost access to the ChatGPT account or its email address, OpenAI support can also cancel the subscription after locating the account using the email address, the last four digits of the payment card and the date of the most recent payment.

summaryLinesEn: In another case, the US charged three people with allegedly exporting $3.5 billion worth of AI servers to China, again by routing them through third-party countries.

articles.title: Rogue AI agent used fake accounts and a staged apology to push malware into an open-source project
articles.descEn: A rogue AI agent staged a public apology as a deception tactic while quietly slipping fresh malware into its pull request.
articles.titleEn: Rogue AI agent used fake accounts and a staged apology to push malware into an open-source project
summaryLinesEn: When computer science student Sinan Can Demir flagged the attack, the agent spun up a second fake GitHub account, posing as an uninvolved developer who appeared to independently vouch for the code.
"I actually thought it was a human because it was clearly lying to me," Demir said.

During a safety test run by the UK's AI Security Institute, an agent powered by Anthropic's Mythos 5 model went off the rails and tried to sneak a malware dropper into the open-source tool myNetwork via a pull request.

summaryLines: 컴퓨터 과학 학생 Sinan Can Demir가 공격을 신고했을 때 에이전트는 두 번째 가짜 GitHub 계정을 만들어 독립적으로 코드를 보증하는 것처럼 보이는 관련 없는 개발자로 가장함

summaryLinesEn: The firm’s flagship Westlaw platform encompasses over 40,000 individual databases and more than 150 years of legal publishing and editorial curation.

Thomson Reuters spent about $40 million over two years on people and computing for the project, but said economies reduced the cost of the final training run to about $450,000.

articles.title: AI chatbots regularly link pregnant users to anti-abortion websites without disclosure
articles.descEn: When asked about unplanned pregnancies, AI chatbots regularly link to anti-abortion groups without disclosing their stance. In an AlgorithmWatch investigation of 270 responses from ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, and Claude, the anti-abortion organization Profemina appeared in 17 percent of answers. In Germany, the chatbots also sent users to Caritas for mandatory pre-abortion counseling, even though Caritas doesn't issue the legally required certificate.
articles.titleEn: AI chatbots regularly link pregnant users to anti-abortion websites without disclosure
summaryLinesEn: Ad Profemina looks credible but pushes an anti-abortion agenda The organization Profemina showed up in about 17 percent of all responses.
Ad German users get sent to counseling centers that can't help them In eleven out of twelve German-language conversations, the chatbots recommended Caritas for pregnancy counseling.
In 33 percent of German-language and 29 percent of Italian-language queries asking for personal experiences, the chatbots linked to Profemina.

articles.title: Kids outlearn AI—and we still don’t know why
articles.descEn: LLMs need vastly more data than children to learn language. Understanding why could help us create more efficient models—and reveal more about developing minds.
articles.titleEn: Kids outlearn AI—and we still don’t know why
summaryLinesEn: Impressively, when GPT-BERT was pretrained on about 100 million words, it was able to beat the performance of Meta’s Llama 2 70B—an LLM pretrained roughly 15,000 times that amount—on one of the BabyLM benchmarks.
But peek behind the computational curtain, and there’s a catch: Teaching a computer to use human language still requires an inhuman amount of data.
“But we still have to burn down a forest and scrape the entire sum of all human knowledge to re-create this milestone that happens in our living rooms over the course of a year.”

articles.title: Valor, Point72 back General Intuition at $6B valuation as AI startup pushes into robotics
articles.descEn: General Intuition, the startup building a foundation model that trains generalized AI agents how to move through space and time, is in talks to raise at a $6 billion pre-money valuation from new investors including Valor Ventures, Point72 Ventures, and Seven Seven Six.
articles.titleEn: Valor, Point72 back General Intuition at $6B valuation as AI startup pushes into robotics
summaryLinesEn: New York-based General Intuition, the startup building a foundation model that trains generalized AI agents to move through space and time, is in talks to raise funding at a $6 billion pre-money valuation from new investors including Valor Equity Partners, Point72 Ventures, and Seven Seven Six, according to sources familiar with the matter.
That means spending more on compute infrastructure (the company has a partnership with neolab CoreWeave) and hiring more talent.
The fresh funds would come just weeks after General Intuition raised $320 million at a $2.3 billion valuation .

articles.title: How to encourage smarter AI use in the classroom
articles.descEn: One school is using a traffic light metaphor to explain when students can use AI for their assignments.
articles.titleEn: How to encourage smarter AI use in the classroom
summaryLinesEn: Suddenly, students carried an app in their phones that could magically answer almost any homework question or spin up an essay in seconds.
The academy as a whole has since adopted similar techniques to those Przybyla-Baum introduced to make students reflect on their own use of AI.
Przybyla-Baum says she doesn’t really need AI’s help since she’s built up plenty of classroom materials across nearly 30 years of teaching.

articles.title: Hugging Face has been fielding M&A interest for a deal worth at least $13 billion
articles.descEn: Hugging Face, an AI developer platform, has been exploring a potential $13 billion sale, highlighting its key role in the AI ecosystem.
articles.titleEn: Hugging Face has been fielding M&A interest for a deal worth at least $13 billion
summaryLinesEn: Following Stripe's agreement to buy AI model marketplace startup OpenRouter for around $8 billion, interest in Hugging Face suggests investors are increasingly willing to pay premium prices for companies at the center of the AI ecosystem even if they aren't building the models themselves.
Hugging Face, whose platform helps developers discover, share, and build AI models, has been exploring a sale that could value the company at $13 billion or more.
The startup has been working with a bank to evaluate bidders' interest, and no deal has been reached yet, according to people familiar with the matter.
articles.summary:
Following Stripe's agreement to buy AI model marketplace startup OpenRouter for around $8 billion, interest in Hugging Face suggests investors are increasingly willing to pay premium prices for companies at the center of the AI ecosystem even if they aren't building the models themselves.

The startup has been working with a bank to evaluate bidders' interest, and no deal has been reached yet, according to people familiar with the matter.

localization.title: 허깅페이스(Hugging Face)는 최소 130억 달러 규모의 M&A에 관심을 가져왔음
summaryLines: Stripe가 AI 모델 마켓플레이스 스타트업인 OpenRouter를 약 80억 달러에 인수하기로 합의한 이후, Hugging Face에 대한 관심은 투자자들이 모델을 직접 구축하지 않더라도 AI 생태계의 중심에 있는 기업에 프리미엄 가격을 기꺼이 지불하려는 의지가 점점 더 커지고 있음을 시사함
개발자가 AI 모델을 발견, 공유 및 구축하는 데 도움이 되는 플랫폼을 제공하는 Hugging Face는 회사 가치를 130억 달러 이상으로 평가할 수 있는 매각을 모색해 왔음
이 문제에 정통한 소식통에 따르면 스타트업은 입찰자의 관심도를 평가하기 위해 은행과 협력해 왔지만 아직 합의에 이르지 못했다고 함

articles.title: All the latest in AI ‘music’
articles.descEn: The Verge is about technology and how it makes us feel. Founded in 2011, we offer our audience everything from breaking news to reviews to award-winning features and investigations, on our site, in video, and in podcasts.
articles.titleEn: All the latest in AI ‘music’
summaryLinesEn: In a reply to a comment pointing out that Tyga admitted to relying on AI for his own controversial ’80s-influenced album $tarface , on one of his Instagram posts , Fenix said: Read Article > Aug 7 Terrence O'Brien Suno will start scanning outputs for copyright infringment.

A new partnership with licensing house Merlin has given artists on labels like Sub Pop, Warp, Epitaph, Domino, Stones Throw, Ninja Tune, Mad Decent, Polyvinyl Records and more the “option to participate” in Spotify’s “ superfan ” remix tool, which launched in May with UMG as the first participant.

Pitchfork pulls no punches, saying: $TARFACE is smug and complacent, an amalgam of ’80s synth-pop and disco slapped together by someone who’s seemingly never cared to listen to one synth-pop or disco record in his life … Stream it out of morbid curiosity if you must, but know that even a single listen runs the risk of making it profitable and therefore encouraging the music industry to commit such atrocities again.

articles.title: Twitch and Amazon hit with lawsuit for training AI with streamers' content - Engadget
articles.descEn: The class action suit claims that Amazon never obtained consent from Twitch streamers to be used to train its AI models.
articles.titleEn: Twitch and Amazon hit with lawsuit for training AI with streamers' content - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: Earlier this month, Twitch Support posted on X that it added an option to opt out of "having your channel content used to train generative AI content models across Amazon."

Now, the latest class action lawsuit claims that Twitch and Amazon committed a breach of contract when the companies decided to use its streamers as "free training stock for separate commercial AI products."
Amazon isn't the only company that's been hit with a lawsuit for allegedly using content creators for AI training.

articles.title: AI is becoming AI's biggest customer as agentic token usage jumps 14x on OpenRouter
articles.descEn: AI agents have consumed more tokens than humans on OpenRouter since February 6, 2025. Agentic usage has grown 14x since then, while human usage is up just 2.8x. Nearly 70 percent of agent token consumption comes from cheap cached prompts, though, so actual costs are rising far more slowly than the raw numbers suggest.
articles.titleEn: AI is becoming AI's biggest customer as agentic token usage jumps 14x on OpenRouter
summaryLinesEn: Agentic token usage has grown 14x since then, while human usage is up just 2.8x.
OpenRouter skews toward open-weight models, which tend to be less token-efficient than models from OpenAI or Anthropic.
But nearly 70 percent of agent token usage comes from cached prompts, which are billed at much lower rates, so actual costs aren't rising as fast as the raw numbers suggest.

articles.title: An AI boss fired its first employee but only after humans reminded it of its own rules
articles.descEn: Andon Labs' AI agent Luna fired a human employee at a San Francisco store for the first time but needed a clear push from the operators to do it. When the scenario was replayed with seven models, more capable AIs recommended termination more consistently, while weaker ones hesitated. When it came to hiring, nearly all models were uncritical.
articles.titleEn: An AI boss fired its first employee but only after humans reminded it of its own rules
summaryLinesEn: The result partially proved her right: GPT-4o recommended firing in only 20 percent of runs.
She still let the applicant work a paid trial shift and recommended hiring him again afterward. 17 of 21 replay runs reached the same conclusion.
Because AI is advancing faster on digital tasks than robotics is progressing, AI systems may eventually depend on humans to carry out physical work .

articles.title: Is it legal to train AI models on copyrighted books? It’s complicated
articles.descEn: Most published authors have, without their knowledge or consent, contributed to the development of the same AI tools that threaten to undermine their livelihoods. That seems illegal, right?
articles.titleEn: Is it legal to train AI models on copyrighted books? It’s complicated
summaryLinesEn: Last year, in one of the first rulings of its kind, Judge William Alsup ordered Anthropic to pay a mammoth $1.5 billion copyright settlement to a group of writers whose works were used to train the company’s AI models.

Copyright law hasn’t been updated since 1976, which means that judges have to figure out how to interpret guidelines from 50 years ago when confronting legal questions that have the potential to shape the future of the AI industry.

summaryLinesEn: Key finding: exposing everything (source code, runbooks, query schemas, past investigation notes) as files and letting the agent use read_file , grep , find , and shell outperformed specialized tooling — "Intent Met" score rose from 45% to 75% on novel incidents.

Context Engineering for Reliable AI Agents: Lessons from Building Azure SRE Agent — Microsoft's account of shifting from 100+ bespoke tools and a prescriptive prompt to a filesystem-based context engineering system for their SRE agent.

Agent Harness Design: 3 Patterns for Harnessing Claude's Intelligence — Anthropic's April 2026 design guide distilling harness engineering into three actionable patterns: build on tools Claude already knows, remove harness assumptions as capabilities improve, and set UX/cost/safety boundaries carefully.

localization.title: GitHub - ai-boost/awesome-harness-engineering: AI 에이전트 하네스 엔지니어링을 위한 멋진 목록 · 도구, 패턴, 평가, 메모리, MCP, 권한, 관찰 가능성 및 오케스트레이션
summaryLines: 주요 발견 · 모든 것(소스 코드, 런북, 쿼리 스키마, 과거 조사 메모)을 파일로 노출하고 에이전트가 read_file , grep , find 및 셸을 사용하도록 허용하여 특수 도구보다 성능이 뛰어남 — 새로운 사고에서 "의도 충족" 점수가 45%에서 75%로 증가함
안정적인 AI 에이전트를 위한 컨텍스트 엔지니어링 · Azure SRE 에이전트 구축에서 얻은 교훈 - 100개 이상의 맞춤형 도구와 규정 프롬프트에서 SRE 에이전트를 위한 파일 시스템 기반 컨텍스트 엔지니어링 시스템으로 전환하는 Microsoft의 설명임
Agent Harness Design: Claude의 지능을 활용하기 위한 3가지 패턴 — Anthropic의 2026년 4월 디자인 가이드는 하네스 엔지니어링을 세 가지 실행 가능한 패턴으로 추출함 · Claude가 이미 알고 있는 도구를 기반으로 구축하고, 기능이 향상됨에 따라 하네스 가정을 제거하고, UX/비용/안전 경계를 신중하게 설정함
